body.en: Bedford County, Pennsylvania, is a destination where you can go beyond the expected. Bedford is where you can leave garden-variety visitor activities behind to seek adventure and experience local culture and surprise. Explorers, creators, caregivers, and historians all have something unique to discover here in south-central west Pennsylvania. From an adrenaline-pumping racetrack to limestone caverns, serene lakes, and quirky roadside attractions, visitors come to enjoy its rich heritage, natural beauty and welcoming spirit. These eight itinerary stops will get you started.
body.zh: 賓州貝德福德郡是一個可以讓您超乎想像的目的地。在貝德福德，您可以拋開各種遊客活動，去尋求冒險、體驗當地文化和驚喜。探險家、創造者、護理人員和歷史學家都可以在賓夕法尼亞州中南部西部發現一些獨特的東西。從令人腎上腺素激增的賽馬場到石灰岩洞穴、寧靜的湖泊和奇特的路邊景點，遊客可以盡情享受這裡豐富的遺產、自然美景和熱情好客的氛圍。這八個行程站點將幫助您開始。

body.en: Perhaps you're already familiar with Primanti sandwiches and Philly cheesesteaks, yet many other cultural culinary treats await you in the Keystone State—you just have to know where to look. From traditional Pennsylvania Dutch meats and inventive, use-it-all creations like scrapple, to a beloved Polish pierogies shop that’s the product of a true American dream, Pennsylvania is packed with surprising gastronomical goodies. Along the way, you’ll discover a 1920s Italian bakery that closely ties its community with timeless tomato pie, two types of tasty Amish treats, an only-in-Philly kind of French fry, and the birthplace of the banana split. So, grab your fork, and let this itinerary guide you on a mouthwatering journey through Pennsylvania's most iconic foods.
body.zh: 也許您已經熟悉 Primanti 三明治和費城起司牛排，但在基斯通州還有許多其他文化美食等著您 — 您只需要知道去哪裡尋找即可。從傳統的賓州荷蘭肉類和創意的、萬能的創意食品（例如碎肉），到深受人們喜愛的波蘭餃子店（這是真正的美國夢的產物），賓州充滿了令人驚嘆的美食。一路上，您會發現一家 1920 年代的意大利麵包店，它與永恆的番茄派、兩種美味的阿米甚美食、費城獨有的炸薯條以及香蕉船的發源地緊密相連。所以，拿起你的叉子，讓這個行程引導您踏上賓州最具代表性食物的令人垂涎的旅程。

body.en: Staunch Swifties surely know that the famous songstress hails from Reading, Pennsylvania. Fewer may know about the fascinating sites to explore throughout Berks County and the stories and history they hold. Take a rural barn tour that highlights historic American folk art, see a celebrated sculpture by pop artist and native son Keith Haring, or enjoy a creative hub housed in a historic safety goggle factory. All this art and culture is surrounded by unparalleled scenery of rolling hills and the Appalachian Mountains. Even casual birders won’t want to miss Berks County’s world-class avian refuge. Get ready for a road trip with welcome surprises at every turn with this nine-stop tour.
body.zh: 堅定的斯威夫特肯定知道這位著名女歌手來自賓夕法尼亞州雷丁。很少有人知道整個伯克斯縣值得探索的迷人景點及其故事和歷史。參加鄉村穀倉之旅，欣賞歷史悠久的美國民間藝術，欣賞流行藝術家和土生土長的兒子基思·哈林 (Keith Haring) 創作的著名雕塑，或享受位於歷史悠久的安全護目鏡工廠內的創意中心。所有這些藝術和文化都被起伏的丘陵和阿巴拉契亞山脈無與倫比的風景所包圍。即使是休閒觀鳥者也不會想錯過伯克斯縣的世界級鳥類保護區。參加這個九站之旅，準備好踏上公路旅行，每次轉彎都會有驚喜。

body.en: While the Juniata River Valley area certainly earns its reputation for beautiful nature, it’s also full of personality and hidden gems. The area’s annual Goose Day festival draws visitors from far and near, and it’s also home to Pennsylvania’s longest covered bridge and the only piece of Abraham Lincon’s tomb outside the state of Illinois. Go birding or catch views of both Big Valley and Ferguson Valley from Jack’s Mountain Overlook, then check out a historical site or two and maybe some antiques before grabbing a bite to eat at a sustainable, locally-owned brewhouse in serene settings. Whatever you do, be sure to take a gander at a few of the valley’s 51 fiberglass geese (and counting), and the iconic 15-foot tall Dairyland Cow in Belleville.
body.zh: 雖然朱尼亞塔河谷地區確實以其美麗的自然風景而聞名，但它也充滿個性和隱藏的寶石。該地區一年一度的鵝節吸引了來自四面八方的遊客，這裡也是賓夕法尼亞州最長的廊橋和伊利諾伊州以外唯一的亞伯拉罕·林肯墓的所在地。去觀鳥或從傑克山觀景台欣賞大山谷和弗格森谷的景色，然後參觀一兩處歷史遺跡，或許還可以看看一些古董，然後在環境寧靜的可持續發展的當地啤酒廠吃點東西。無論您做什麼，請務必看看山谷中 51 隻玻璃纖維鵝（數量還在增加），以及貝爾維爾標誌性的 15 英尺高的乳牛場乳牛。

body.en: Williamsport, Pennsylvania, is a city perched on the winding Susquehanna River, and at the foot of nearby Bald Eagle Mountain. This dynamic position means that the area is popular with outdoor enthusiasts, thanks to the 300,000 acres of state gamelands that surround the city; and it’s also a place with a rich social and industrial history, thanks to the power of that river. In the 1800s, Williamsport was dubbed the Lumber Capital of the World, and the river helped carry all that wood to destinations across the region. This also meant a boom of wealth for the small city, which to this day is still full of grand mansions once erected by logging barons. Beyond that timber history, this small city is packed with wonder and stories, from a firefighter terrified of being buried alive to an enterprising local who figured that kids should have their own baseball league. And while the surrounding nature is very popular in the warmer months, these diverse attractions make Williamsport a wonderful, off-the-beaten path destination for autumn and winter travel as well. Especially when those seasonal beers are on tap at Rosko’s Brew House, a craft brewery located in a nearly 200-year-old home. The list is as diverse as the city itself—so consider these stops for your next adventure.
body.zh: 賓州威廉斯波特是個坐落在蜿蜒的薩斯奎哈納河畔、附近禿鷹山腳下的城市。這種充滿活力的位置意味著該地區深受戶外愛好者的歡迎，這要歸功於城市周圍 300,000 英畝的州立遊戲場；由於河流的力量，這裡也是一個擁有豐富社會和工業歷史的地方。 1800 年代，威廉斯波特被稱為世界木材之都，河流幫助將所有木材運送到該地區的各個目的地。這也意味著這座小城市的財富繁榮，時至今日，這座小城市仍然充滿了伐木大亨曾經建造的豪宅。除了木材歷史之外，這座小城市還充滿了奇蹟和故事，從害怕被活埋的消防員到認為孩子們應該擁有自己的棒球聯盟的積極進取的當地人。雖然周圍的自然風光在溫暖的月份非常受歡迎，但這些多樣化的景點使威廉斯波特成為秋季和冬季旅行的絕佳、人跡罕至的目的地。尤其是當 Rosko’s Brew House 供應季節性啤酒時，這棟精釀啤酒廠位於一棟擁有近 200 年歷史的住宅內。該清單與城市本身一樣多樣化 - 因此，請在您的下一次冒險中考慮這些網站。

body.en: Georgia’s rich history made it fertile ground for cultural change, from the Civil Rights movement to the fusion of influences that powered Southern soul, R&B, and rock music. Nowhere can this be more keenly felt than in the cities of Macon and Augusta. Music pumps through the very heart of Macon. This city in central Georgia was the launching pad for iconic artists like Otis Redding, Little Richard, and the Allman Brothers Band. These musicians pioneered styles that brought them worldwide fame, but they all cut their musical teeth here. These legacies are very much alive and ready to explore. Not far away, along the Savannah River in Augusta, curious travelers can explore the region’s singular role in Black history at the home of the oldest African-American congregation. You can learn about Augusta’s own James Brown and much more at the Augusta Museum of History. The city is also well-known for hosting the Masters golf tournament every spring, but its enticing destinations and welcoming atmosphere make it a compelling destination year-round.
body.zh: 喬治亞州豐富的歷史使其成為文化變革的沃土，從民權運動到推動南方靈魂音樂、R&B 和搖滾音樂的影響力的融合。沒有什麼地方比梅肯和奧古斯塔市更能強烈地感受到這一點了。音樂貫穿梅肯的心臟。這座位於喬治亞州中部的城市是奧蒂斯·雷丁、小理查德和奧爾曼兄弟樂隊等標誌性藝術家的發源地。這些音樂家所開創的風格為他們帶來了世界性的聲譽，但他們都是在這裡嶄露頭角的。這些遺產非常活躍，隨時可供探索。不遠處，沿著奧古斯塔的薩凡納河，好奇的旅行者可以在最古老的非裔美國人教會的所在地探索該地區在黑人歷史中的獨特作用。您可以在奧古斯塔歷史博物館了解奧古斯塔自己的詹姆斯布朗等更多資訊。這座城市也因每年春季舉辦高爾夫大師賽而聞名，但其誘人的目的地和熱情的氛圍使其成為全年引人注目的目的地。

body.en: Head to the Laurel Highlands and you’ll find a region rich in history, architecture, and natural beauty. Whether you’re looking for design inspiration or seeking wilderness views and thrills, the southwestern Pennsylvania destination, about an hour outside of Pittsburgh, has something for you. This itinerary includes architectural landmarks, including several of Frank Lloyd Wright’s iconic homes, hiking and biking trails, and more. An ideal place to start is Wright’s famous Fallingwater home. Take this chance to explore organic architecture and learn more about midcentury design. Immerse yourself in even more architectural beauty at Kentuck Knob or Polymath Park. For a more active adventures, head out to Ohiopyle State Park, where you can hike and bike, and experience Laurel Caverns, which is on track to become Pennsylvania’s first underground state park.
body.zh: 前往勞雷爾高地，您會發現這個地區擁有豐富的歷史、建築和自然美景。無論您是尋找設計靈感還是尋求荒野景觀和刺激，距離匹茲堡約一小時車程的賓州西南部目的地都能滿足您的需求。此行程包括建築地標，包括弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特 (Frank Lloyd Wright) 的幾座標誌性住宅、徒步旅行和自行車道等。賴特著名的流水別墅是一個理想的起點。藉此機會探索有機建築並了解更多有關中世紀設計的資訊。前往 Kentuck Knob 或 Polymath Park，沉浸在更美麗的建築中。如果您想要進行更活躍的冒險，可以前往俄亥俄派爾州立公園 (Ohiopyle State Park)，在那裡您可以徒步旅行和騎自行車，並體驗勞雷爾洞穴 (Laurel Caverns)，這裡有望成為賓夕法尼亞州第一個地下州立公園。

body.en: Happy Valley is a central Pennsylvania region with an unusual nickname: one it earned thanks to the area’s economic resilience during the Great Depression. As the home of Penn State University, the moniker “Happy Valley” became popularized in the second half of the 20th century, thanks to college sports announcers and local newspaper columnists, and it’s gladly stuck. The region consists of State College and other picturesque small towns like Bellefonte, Millheim, Centre Hall, and Philipsburg. It’s also home to a wealth of curious, rare, and ready-to-explore attractions, from the oldest university creamery in the U.S. to the largest stalagmite in Pennsylvania. Visitors can see North America’s most extensive collection of artifacts relating to 15th-century explorer Christopher Columbus; visit one of the world's largest public-access libraries devoted to postal stamps and postal history; or take a motorboat through the only all-water cavern in the U.S. There are also swampy boglands, a wintering bat cave, and jaw-dropping works of art, among other unexpected offerings. Come and experience them for yourself!
body.zh: 歡樂谷是賓州中部地區，有一個不尋常的綽號：由於該地區在大蕭條期間的經濟韌性而得名。作為賓州州立大學的所在地，「歡樂谷」這個綽號在 20 世紀下半葉因大學體育播音員和當地報紙專欄作家而變得流行起來，並且很高興地被保留了下來。該地區由州立學院城和其他風景如畫的小鎮組成，如貝爾方特、米爾海姆、中心霍爾和菲利普斯堡。這裡也有大量奇特、稀有且值得探索的景點，從美國最古老的大學乳品廠到賓州最大的石筍。遊客可以看到北美最豐富的與 15 世紀探險家克里斯托弗·哥倫布有關的文物收藏；參觀世界上最大的致力於郵票和郵政歷史的公共圖書館之一；或者乘坐摩托艇穿過美國唯一的全水洞穴。這裡還有沼澤沼澤、過冬的蝙蝠洞和令人驚嘆的藝術品，以及其他意想不到的東西。快來親自體驗吧！

body.en: Tucked in the northeastern corner of Pennsylvania, the Pocono Mountain region tells a story of American industry, natural wonder, and cultural heritage. From the anthracite coal veins that powered a nation to ancient geological formations that predate recorded history, this corner of the Keystone State offers visitors a unique blend of rugged beauty and fascinating historical narratives. A short, scenic drive from nearby Philadelphia or New York City, the Poconos encompass four counties—Carbon, Monroe, Pike, and Wayne—each with its own collection of things to do. Descend 1,600 feet into the earth to explore the longest continuously operated deep mine in the world, clamber across boulder fields unchanged since the last ice age, and visit a farm where Pennsylvania German traditions remain vibrant. If you’re drawn to industrial history, the elegance of Gilded Age craftsmanship, or the simple pleasures of a countryside escape, the Poconos invite you to explore America’s past surrounded by enduring natural beauty.
body.zh: 波科諾山區位於賓州東北角，講述了美國工業、自然奇觀和文化遺產的故事。從為一個國家提供動力的無菸煤礦脈到早於有記載的歷史的古老地質構造，基斯通州的這個角落為遊客提供了粗獷之美和迷人歷史敘事的獨特融合。波科諾斯距離附近的費城或紐約市只有很短的車程，風景優美，涵蓋四個縣：卡本縣、門羅縣、派克縣和韋恩縣，每個縣都有自己的特色活動。深入地下 1,600 英尺，探索世界上持續運營時間最長的深礦，攀爬自上一個冰河時代以來一成不變的巨石田，並參觀賓夕法尼亞州德國傳統仍然充滿活力的農場。如果您對工業歷史、鍍金時代的優雅工藝或鄉村度假的簡單樂趣感興趣，波科諾斯邀請您探索美國的過去，周圍環繞著持久的自然美景。

body.en: As one of the three original counties of the Commonwealth, Chester County offers a unique glimpse into historic Pennsylvania. From the old courthouse in West Chester, the oldest public building in the United States, to the Lincoln Building where Abraham Lincoln’s first published biography was housed in 1860, reminders of the past are around every bend. A quick drive down I-76 from Philadelphia, Chester County blends historic architecture with unique local agriculture and a one-of-a-kind public garden, paired with a thriving local arts scene. Kick off your long weekend at one of the oldest functioning mills in America and spend a contemplative moment in a hidden grotto with a waterfall. As you traverse Brandywine Valley, you’ll explore the Mushroom Capital of the World and sample the offerings of cafés with old-world charm and modern fine dining establishments specializing in local ingredients.
body.zh: 作為英聯邦最初的三個縣之一，切斯特縣提供了了解歷史悠久的賓夕法尼亞州的獨特視角。從美國最古老的公共建築——西切斯特的老法院，到 1860 年存放亞伯拉罕·林肯第一本傳記的林肯大廈，每個角落都充滿了對過去的回憶。從費城開車沿著 76 號州際公路快速行駛，切斯特縣將歷史建築與獨特的當地農業和獨特的公共花園以及繁榮的當地藝術景觀融為一體。在美國最古老的磨坊之一開始您的長週末，並在帶有瀑布的隱藏石窟中度過沉思的時刻。當您穿越布蘭迪谷時，您將探索世界蘑菇之都，品嚐具有舊世界魅力的咖啡館和專門採用當地食材烹製的現代高級餐廳。

body.en: The town of Hershey, Pennsylvania, is best known as the birthplace of Hershey’s chocolate, but this unincorporated community just east of Harrisburg is also home to sweet sites in addition to the rollercoasters and roaming characters of Hersheypark. Make your way towards the old chocolate factory's iconic (and nonoperational) twin smokestacks and visit a quirky brewery, a truly ancient box huckleberry shrub, and the largest collection of Tucker cars, aka “The Car of Tomorrow,” on the planet. Of course, this one-time company town wouldn’t exist without the chocolatier himself, Milton S. Hershey, the businessman and philanthropist whose creations span wider than iconic chocolates and theme parks. Today, you can wander around 23 acres of gardens, indulge in chocolate fondue wraps and whipped cocoa baths, and make your own chocolate masterpieces, all thanks to Hershey’s early vision.
body.zh: 賓州的好時鎮以好時巧克力的發源地而聞名，但這個位於哈里斯堡以東的非法人社區除了好時公園的過山車和漫遊角色之外，還擁有許多甜蜜的景點。前往老巧克力工廠標誌性的（且已停止運作的）雙煙囪，參觀一家奇特的啤酒廠、一株真正古老的箱形越橘灌木，以及地球上最大的塔克汽車收藏，又名「明日汽車」。當然，如果沒有巧克力製造商米爾頓·S·好時 (Milton S. Hershey) 本人，這個曾經的公司小鎮就不會存在。這位商人和慈善家的創作範圍不僅限於標誌性巧克力和主題樂園。如今，您可以在 23 英畝的花園中漫步，盡情享受巧克力火鍋捲和攪打可可浴，並製作自己的巧克力傑作，這一切都歸功於好時的早期遠見。

body.en: One of America’s most walkable cities, Philadelphia is a vibrant urban playground that asks visitors to engage with its culture through all their senses. Visitors encounter historic landmarks and iconic American architecture next to quirky public art installations, and will find fine dining and street food establishments held in comparable esteem—sometimes right next door to each other. Speaking of food, dining is a cultural pastime in Philly, with options catering to both the gourmet and the gourmand. Find the best meals of your life in tiny shops without websites, and in the sweeping hospitality of traditional weekend brunch buffets. Between meals, make a walking tour of architectural landmarks, museums, and special collections like the aptly-named Magic Gardens: a sprawling immersive mosaic installation in the South Street neighborhood.
body.zh: 費城是美國最適合步行的城市之一，是一個充滿活力的城市遊樂場，要求遊客透過所有感官參與其文化。遊客會在奇特的公共藝術設施旁邂逅歷史地標和標誌性的美國建築，並會發現同樣受人尊敬的高級餐廳和街頭小吃店——有時甚至毗鄰。說到美食，餐飲是費城的文化消遣，有許多選擇可以滿足美食家和美食愛好者的需求。在沒有網站的小商店和傳統週末早午餐自助餐的熱情款待中找到您一生中最好的飯菜。兩餐之間，步行遊覽建築地標、博物館和特殊收藏品，例如名副其實的魔法花園：南街附近一個龐大的沉浸式馬賽克裝置。

body.en: You may not know it, but Pennsylvania has its own wild west. Instead of saloons and gunslingers, this region is full of old growth forests, endless trails, untouched wilderness, winding rivers, and so much history. This is Clarion County, home to the 6,000-acre Cook Forest as well as sections of the Allegheny and Clarion Rivers. While this beautifully preserved area is ideal for outdoors adventures—from hiking, trail biking, and ATV rides to river exploration in the warmer months—it’s also home to plenty of history. You can start your day with a scenic overlook or two, visit the country’s oldest golf course in continuous use, then walk or bike Rail Trail 66 before stopping off at Lost in the Wilds Brewery for a pint or two of local brew. The lush, untouched nature shares space with curiosities like an enormous roadside cow and a possibly haunted old house that doubles as a local museum. Note that there isn’t any public transportation in Clarion County, and cellphone reception can be spotty. So you’ll want to bring (or rent) your own car to explore in, and pick up a map through AAA, at the Cook Forest ranger station, or access maps and brochures here. What better place to escape the screens and embrace that off-the-grid, adventurous spirit.
body.zh: 您可能不知道，賓州也有自己的狂野西部。這個地區沒有酒吧和槍手，而是充滿了古老的森林、無盡的小徑、未受破壞的荒野、蜿蜒的河流和悠久的歷史。這是克拉里昂縣，擁有 6,000 英畝的庫克森林以及阿勒格尼河和克拉里昂河的部分地區。雖然這個保存完好的地區非常適合戶外探險——從徒步旅行、越野自行車、全地形車騎行到溫暖月份的河流探索——但它也擁有豐富的歷史。您可以欣賞一兩處風景，參觀全國最古老且仍在使用的高爾夫球場，然後步行或騎自行車沿著 66 號鐵路小徑開始新的一天，然後在 Lost in the Wilds 啤酒廠停下來喝一兩品脫當地啤酒。鬱鬱蔥蔥、未受破壞的大自然與好奇心共享空間，例如路邊的一頭巨大的牛和一座可能鬧鬼的老房子，同時也是當地的博物館。請注意，克拉里昂縣沒有任何公共交通，手機訊號訊號也不穩定。因此，您需要自備（或租用）自己的汽車來探索，並透過 AAA 在庫克森林護林站獲取地圖，或在此處獲取地圖和小冊子。還有什麼比這裡更好的地方來逃離螢幕並擁抱脫離網路的冒險精神呢？

body.en: From a historic 19th-century firehouse that’s now housing a privately owned Roberto Clemente museum, to a family-run distillery located in a historically preserved carriage house and the last remaining vestiges of Pittsburgh's once-thriving steel industry, Pittsburgh has a surprising amount of intriguing re-imagined spaces. A feisty sculptor’s dilapidated rowhouse evolved into a thriving contemporary art museum. A lighthouse, taxidermied bear, and a graveyard are features of four art houses you can now tour. And a husband’s loving promise to build his wife a castle turned into one of Pittsburgh’s most enchanting dining experiences. Use this nine-stop itinerary to explore Pittsburgh beyond what you think you already know about Steel City.
body.zh: 從歷史悠久的 19 世紀消防站（現為私人羅伯托·克萊門特博物館），到位於歷史悠久的馬車房內的家族經營釀酒廠，以及匹茲堡曾經繁榮的鋼鐵工業僅存的遺跡，匹茲堡擁有數量驚人的有趣的重新想像的空間。一位精力充沛的雕塑家破舊的排屋演變成了一座欣欣向榮的當代藝術博物館。燈塔、熊標本和墓地是您現在可以參觀的四座藝術館的特色。丈夫為妻子建造一座城堡的深情承諾變成了匹茲堡最迷人的用餐體驗之一。利用這個九站行程，探索匹茲堡，超越您對鋼鐵城的了解。

body.en: Tucked in the northwest corner of Pennsylvania, just south of Lake Erie, Crawford County is full of fascinating places to explore. From a historic site that changed the course of the oil industry and a museum dedicated to one of the world’s largest producers of stereographs, there’s no shortage of intriguing sites in Crawford County. In between, you’ll find miles of scenic hiking and biking trails packed with birds and other wildlife, including a peaceful refuge with protected mussels and other species. A whimsical roadside art sculpture made of metal street signs is a worthy stop, and you’ll want to sample one brewery’s food and beer infused with maple from a nearby family farm. Use this guide to get going on your Crawford County adventure.
body.zh: 克勞福德縣位於賓夕法尼亞州西北角，伊利湖以南，充滿了迷人的地方值得探索。從改變石油工業進程的歷史遺址到專門紀念世界上最大的立體照片生產商之一的博物館，克勞福德縣不乏引人入勝的景點。在其間，您會發現綿延數英里的風景優美的遠足和自行車道，這裡擠滿了鳥類和其他野生動物，還有一個寧靜的避難所，裡面有受保護的貽貝和其他物種。由金屬路標製成的奇特路邊藝術雕塑值得一去，您會想品嚐啤酒廠的食物和來自附近家庭農場的楓木啤酒。使用本指南開始您的克勞福德縣冒險之旅。

body.en: Perched on the southern shore of its namesake Great Lake, Erie, Pennsylvania is a port town with a rich history and a treasure chest of natural wonders. Where else can you hike through six ecosystems in one waterfront park? The area is home to the state’s only sandy beaches, savannas, waterfalls, and hundreds of exotic birds like the roving plover. It’s also heaping with local charm and out-of-the-ordinary fun. From grabbing breakfast at a retro “dinor” with a unique regional spelling to hiking along bluffs to soak up jaw-dropping views of Lake Erie, this itinerary unearths the area’s hidden gems (including the two ultimate sunset spots in the county). Along the way, take in a minor league baseball game—with all its offbeat customs—and visit the burial site of General “Mad” Anthony Wayne, who was dug up and boiled (we’ll explain). End your day by grabbing a craft beer and bite in an iconic train station that has hosted presidents, sports greats, and—some locals say—ghosts.
body.zh: 賓州伊利市坐落在同名五大湖的南岸，是個擁有豐富歷史和自然奇觀寶庫的港口小鎮。還有哪裡可以在一個海濱公園徒步穿越六個生態系統？該地區擁有該州唯一的沙灘、稀樹草原、瀑布和數百種外來鳥類（如鴴）。它也充滿了當地的魅力和非同尋常的樂趣。從在具有獨特地區拼字的復古“dinor”餐廳享用早餐，到沿著懸崖徒步旅行，欣賞令人驚嘆的伊利湖美景，此行程將發掘該地區隱藏的瑰寶（包括該縣的兩個終極日落景點）。一路上，觀看一場小聯盟棒球比賽——及其各種另類的習俗——並參觀“瘋狂”安東尼·韋恩將軍的墓地，他被挖出來煮了（我們將解釋）。最後，您可以在標誌性的火車站喝杯精釀啤酒，吃點東西來結束一天的生活，這裡曾經接待過總統、體育明星，還有一些當地人說還有鬼魂。

body.en: Central Pennsylvania’s Susquehanna River Valley is bucolic Americana at its finest, with small town vibes and lush greenery fed by the meandering river. The quirky, the quaint, and the unexpected are on order in the region, which spans Union, Snyder, and Northumberland counties. A jaunt through the area reveals the hospitality of small town America in the valley’s charming wineries, antique stores, and mom-and-pop eateries. This region of Pennsylvania holds intriguing sites in American history, and preservation is of strong value to locals. Landmarked sites and structures can be found throughout the region, along with walking tours to contextualize the artifacts of another era. You’ll also want to partake of the river valley’s other signature charm: The area is considered a playground for outdoor adventure and sport, thanks to the sweeping greenspaces that surround the Susquehanna River. On a road trip (or bike ride, if you’re very ambitious) from town to town, stop for beloved local noshes like hot dogs at the Squeeze-In, enjoy the SRV’s many outdoor recreation areas, and check out artifacts that reflect the country’s founding era.
body.zh: 賓州中部的薩斯奎哈納河谷 (Susquehanna River Valley) 是美國田園風光的巔峰之作，擁有小鎮氛圍和蜿蜒河流滋養的鬱鬱蔥蔥的綠色植物。該地區跨越聯合縣、斯奈德縣和諾森伯蘭縣，充滿了奇特、古雅和意想不到的事物。遊覽該地區，在山谷中迷人的酒莊、古董店和夫妻餐廳中感受美國小鎮的熱情好客。賓州的這個地區擁有美國歷史上引人入勝的遺址，保護這些遺址對當地人來說具有很大的價值。整個地區都有地標遺址和建築，也可以步行遊覽，了解另一個時代的文物。您還想體驗河谷的其他標誌性魅力：由於薩斯奎哈納河周圍廣闊的綠地，該地區被認為是戶外探險和運動的遊樂場。在從一個城鎮到另一個城鎮的公路旅行（或騎自行車，如果您雄心勃勃）中，可以在 Squeeze-In 停下來品嚐熱狗等深受喜愛的當地小吃，享受 SRV 的眾多戶外休閒區，並參觀反映該國建國時代的文物。

body.en: Have you ridden in a refurbished open-air 1927 steam locomotive? Or tunneled through a former coal mine? Maybe you’re keen to explore a roadside “geyser,” and the hand-dug underground caves of the country’s oldest brewery? There’s something surprising and new around every turn in Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania. In addition to the thrills of the attractions, you’ll also find dozens of peaceful, scenic hiking trails in two state parks, plus impressive wildlife sightings from loons to bald eagles. Explore the country’s first refuge for birds of prey or stop for a picnic by a serene waterfall. This seven-stop itinerary is designed for you to experience the many surprises that await in Schuylkill County (insiders know it's pronounced SKOO-kl) in eastern Pennsylvania.
body.zh: 您乘坐過翻新的 1927 年露天蒸汽機車嗎？或是穿過一個前煤礦挖隧道？也許您熱衷於探索路邊的“間歇泉”，以及該國最古老的啤酒廠手工挖掘的地下洞穴？賓州斯庫爾基爾縣的每個角落都會有一些令人驚訝和新鮮的事情。除了刺激的景點之外，您還可以在兩個州立公園內找到數十條寧靜、風景優美的遠足小徑，以及從潛鳥到禿鷹等令人印象深刻的野生動物景觀。探索該國第一個猛禽保護區，或在寧靜的瀑布旁停下來野餐。這個七站行程旨在讓您體驗賓夕法尼亞州東部斯庫爾基爾縣（內部人士知道它的發音為 SKOO-kl）的眾多驚喜。

body.en: From its days as a major center for iron ore production to nearly 200 years of crafting an iconic brand of acoustic guitar, eastern Pennsylvania’s Lehigh Valley offers unique experiences around every turn. Situated about 66 miles north of Philadelphia, this mix of urban centers and pastoral farmland is oozing with history, and ample attractions to boot. Spend an afternoon exploring the ruins of an old anthracite furnace in a spectacularly wooded park, dine on escargot and lobster in an old-school eatery that resembles the interior of a ship, or catch a double-feature at the world’s oldest operating drive-in theater. Whether it’s sampling a hand-crafted guitar reminiscent of rock star legends or cheering on track cyclists under Friday night lights, these Lehigh Valley attractions are sure to thrill, delight, and inspire.
body.zh: 從作為鐵礦石生產主要中心的時代，到近 200 年來製作標誌性原聲吉他品牌的歷史，賓夕法尼亞州東部的利哈伊谷 (Lehigh Valley) 處處提供獨特的體驗。這個城市中心和田園農田的結合體位於費城以北約 66 英里處，歷史悠久，擁有眾多景點。花一個下午的時間在樹木茂盛的公園裡探索古老無菸煤爐的廢墟，在類似船內部的老式餐廳裡享用蝸牛和龍蝦，或者在世界上最古老的汽車影院觀看雙幕電影。無論是品嚐讓人想起搖滾明星傳奇的手工吉他，還是在周五夜晚的燈光下為場地自行車運動員加油，這些利哈伊谷的景點一定會令人興奮、愉悅和鼓舞。

body.en: In the canon of mainland United States vacation spots, North Carolina’s Northern Outer Banks region is a hidden gem. Classic Americana-by-the-sea but far less traveled than your typical beachside outpost, The Northern Outer Banks is beloved by families, golfers, outdoor enthusiasts, and American history buffs alike. Those who return year after year relish the area’s seclusion, its miles of pristine Atlantic beach, and the quaint pleasures of towns like Corolla. The northernmost region of “The OBX” includes over 20 miles of shoreline, and 14 distinct picturesque communities. The Northern Outer Banks is a classic, but the region offers much more than a beach backdrop—like wild horses. The Corolla wild horses are the genetic descendants of Spanish Mustangs brought to America by Spanish explorers in the 16th century, and their unique association with the Outer Banks has earned them the distinction of State Horse of North Carolina. They roam freely on Carova Beach, where vacationers and locals safely and respectfully share their time watching these wild beauties while enjoying the sound of the tide. But that’s just the beginning; a trip to The Northern Outer Banks has something for everyone.
body.zh: 在美國大陸度假勝地的經典中，北卡羅來納州的北外灘地區是一顆隱藏的寶石。北外灘群島是典型的美國海濱風情，但比典型的海濱前哨基地遊客少得多，深受家庭、高爾夫球手、戶外運動愛好者和美國歷史愛好者的喜愛。年復一年返回這裡的人都喜歡這裡的僻靜、綿延數英里的原始大西洋海灘以及卡羅拉等城鎮的古樸樂趣。 「OBX」最北端的地區擁有 20 多英里的海岸線和 14 個風景如畫的獨特社區。北外灘群島是一個經典之地，但該地區提供的不僅僅是海灘背景——如野馬。卡羅拉野馬是 16 世紀西班牙探險家帶到美國的西班牙野馬的基因後代，它們與外灘群島的獨特聯繫為它們贏得了北卡羅來納州州馬的稱號。它們在卡羅瓦海灘上自由漫步，度假者和當地人安全而恭敬地分享他們的時光，一邊欣賞這些狂野的美景，一邊欣賞潮汐的聲音。但這只是開始；北外灘群島之旅適合每個人。

body.en: Gettysburg is synonymous with historical significance. Each year, thousands of visitors, from regional school groups to international travelers, flock to the town to walk in the footsteps of the soldiers and civilians who lived through the bloodiest battle of the U.S. Civil War. But even the most avid history buffs may be surprised by the sites beyond Gettysburg’s battlefield legacy. From a circular barn and a secret hideaway in a historic home, to the lesser-known war stories of children, free Black townspeople, women, and more, this itinerary delivers Gettysburg’s key historical sites and its under-the-radar oddities.
body.zh: 葛底斯堡是歷史意義的代名詞。每年，成千上萬的遊客，從地區學校團體到國際遊客，湧入小鎮，追尋經歷美國內戰最血腥戰鬥的士兵和平民的足跡。但即使是最熱心的歷史愛好者也可能會對葛底斯堡戰場遺產以外的遺址感到驚訝。從圓形穀倉和歷史悠久的住宅中的秘密藏身之處，到兒童、自由黑人城鎮居民、婦女等鮮為人知的戰爭故事，此行程將帶您了解葛底斯堡的主要歷史遺址及其不為人知的奇特之處。

body.en: It is the most fabled of American highways, so venerated that it’s known as the Mother Road. (John Steinbeck nicknamed it this in his 1939 novel “The Grapes of Wrath.”) In 2026, lovers of the classic American road trip will celebrate 100 years of getting their kicks on Route 66. While the road was officially decommissioned long ago, the last chunk bypassed in 1984 by a modern highway, Route 66’s hold on our imagination has only tightened since, and significant traces—and treasures—of the road’s heyday can be plumbed along the way, from the bustle of downtown Chicago to the Santa Monica Pier half a continent away. Explore the historic roadway just within Illinois and you’ll see 301 miles of Americana, featuring a bevy of Lincoln statues, roadside giants, and quirky spots (something I know a bit about as the author of “The Great American Retro Road Trip”). Route 66 begins in downtown Chicago, yards from Lake Michigan, and ends on the shores of the Mississippi River with the St. Louis Gateway Arch glistening in the distance. Now buckle up for this Illinois drive that’ll fuel body, mind, and spirit.
body.zh: 它是美國最具傳奇色彩的高速公路，備受尊崇，被稱為「母親之路」。 （約翰·史坦貝克在 1939 年的小說《憤怒的葡萄》中給它起了個綽號。）到 2026 年，美國經典公路旅行的愛好者們將慶祝 66 號公路 100 週年。雖然這條公路很久以前就正式退役，最後一塊路段於 1984 年被現代高速公路繞過，但從那時起，66 號公路對我們想像力的控制力只增不減，以及 66 號公路的重要痕跡和寶藏。從熙熙攘攘的芝加哥市中心到半個大陸外的聖莫尼卡碼頭，您可以一路探索這條路的鼎盛時期。探索伊利諾伊州內歷史悠久的道路，您將看到 301 英里的美國風情，其中有一群林肯雕像、路邊巨人和奇特的景點（作為《偉大的美國復古公路旅行》的作者，我對此有所了解）。 66 號公路始於芝加哥市中心，距離密西根湖幾碼遠，終點位於密西西比河畔，遠處是閃閃發光的聖路易斯大拱門。現在請繫好安全帶，踏上伊利諾伊州的駕車之旅，為身體、思想和精神注入活力。

body.en: First things first: There's no wrong time to visit Mariposa County, home to much of Yosemite National Park, nestled in the foothills of California’s Sierra Nevada mountains. Named for the butterflies that flock to the region, Mariposa is picture-perfect nearly any day of the year. But on weekdays and in the off-season, when Yosemite’s tourists have dispersed, the county’s natural beauty and historic charm shine their brightest. Meander through the ghostly ruins in Hornitos, marvel at the ancient giant sequoias in Mariposa Grove, and let Olmsted Point serve as your private observatory of the Milky Way. Just be sure to plan accordingly: Some Yosemite landmarks close due to heavy snowfall in the winter months, so you’ll want to check ahead before hitting the road.
body.zh: 首先，遊覽馬里波薩縣沒有錯誤的時間，該縣是約塞米蒂國家公園大部分地區的所在地，坐落在加州內華達山脈的山麓上。馬里波薩因聚集在該地區的蝴蝶而得名，幾乎一年中的任何一天都風景如畫。但在平日和淡季，當優勝美地的遊客散去時，這個縣的自然美景和歷史魅力才會綻放出最耀眼的光芒。蜿蜒穿過霍尼托斯的幽靈般的廢墟，驚嘆於馬里波薩格羅夫的古老巨型紅杉，並讓奧姆斯特德角作為您的銀河系私人天文台。請務必做好相應的計劃：優勝美地的一些地標因冬季大雪而關閉，因此您需要在上路之前提前檢查一下。

body.en: Along with its stately magnolias and sweet, welcoming charm, Mississippi has a surprising hidden, and some say, haunted side. Journey beyond the familiar homes of Elvis Presley, William Faulkner, and Tennessee Williams, to the misty, kudzu-covered backroads, where shadowy figures roam haunted estates, long-dead soldiers frequent centuries-old cemeteries, and abandoned structures lure spirited visitors. Start your tour in Yazoo City, the gateway to the Delta, at the grave of a long-feared witch who once put a hex on the town. In Vicksburg, take a candlelight paranormal tour of one of the most haunted places in all of Mississippi, then head to Natchez to see a cemetery statue that some say comes to life at night. In between, you’ll find apparition-packed gravesites, one seriously haunted theater, and the site of a legendary deal with the devil.
body.zh: 除了莊嚴的木蘭花和甜美、熱情的魅力之外，密西西比州還有令人驚訝的隱藏的一面，有人說是鬧鬼的一面。離開貓王艾維斯普萊斯利、威廉福克納和田納西威廉斯熟悉的家，來到霧氣濛濛、葛藤覆蓋的小路，那裡陰暗的人物在鬧鬼的莊園裡漫步，死去已久的士兵經常出現在有數百年曆史的墓地裡，廢棄的建築吸引著精神抖擻的遊客。從亞祖市開始您的旅程，亞祖市是通往三角洲的門戶，那裡有一位令人畏懼的女巫的墳墓，這位女巫曾在該鎮施下咒語。在維克斯堡，參加密西西比州最鬧鬼的地方之一的燭光超自然之旅，然後前往納奇茲觀看一座墓地雕像，有人說這座雕像在晚上會復活。在其間，您會發現充滿幽靈的墓地、一座鬧鬼的劇院，以及與魔鬼進行傳奇交易的地點。

body.en: Santa Fe’s culinary scene is steeped in history and heritage. Thanks to the trade routes that once ran through the city, the local cuisine mixes far-flung ingredients with produce grown nearby in the high mountain desert climate—like blue corn, beans, and chiles sought after by chefs in every corner of the world. The city’s top-flight eateries draw inspiration from these local flavors, as well as cuisines from Old Mexico, Asia, the Middle East, and South America, to create unique dining experiences you won’t find anywhere else. So what are you waiting for?
body.zh: 聖塔菲的美食有著悠久的歷史和傳統。由於曾經穿過這座城市的貿易路線，當地美食將遙遠的食材與附近高山沙漠氣候下種植的農產品混合在一起，如世界各地廚​​師追捧的藍玉米、豆類和辣椒。該市的頂級餐廳從這些當地風味以及來自舊墨西哥、亞洲、中東和南美洲的美食中汲取靈感，創造出在其他地方找不到的獨特用餐體驗。那你還在等什麼？

body.en: With more than 400 miles of explored passageways, Kentucky’s Mammoth Cave is the longest known cave system on the planet. It’s a world of layered limestone, remarkable stalagmites and stalactites, dark underground tunnels, vast open chambers, and thousands of years of human history. Together with 52,830 acres of forests and rivers, Mammoth Cave became a national park in 1941. The caves were designated as an UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1981, and in 1990, an International Biosphere Reserve. Simply put, the park and its surrounds are remarkable, beckoning visitors with an array of adventures ranging from offbeat to sublime. Whether it’s careening down an alpine slide or crawling your way through low-lying stretches on a six-hour subterranean tour, here are 10 ways to experience this wondrous place in all its mouth-gaping glory. So grab a paddle (or a kerosene lantern), hop on a bike or book a stay in a wigwam and get ready to explore.
body.zh: 肯塔基州的猛獁洞擁有超過 400 英里的探索通道，是地球上已知最長的洞穴系統。這是一個充滿層狀石灰岩、引人注目的石筍和鐘乳石、黑暗的地下隧道、巨大的開放房間和數千年人類歷史的世界。猛獁洞連同佔地 52,830 英畝的森林和河流，於 1941 年成為國家公園。這些洞穴於 1981 年被指定為聯合國教科文組織世界遺產，並於 1990 年被指定為國際生物圈保護區。簡而言之，公園及其周邊地區非常引人注目，以一系列從另類到崇高的冒險活動吸引遊客。無論是從高山滑梯上傾瀉而下，還是在 6 小時的地下之旅中爬過低窪地帶，這裡有 10 種方式來體驗這個奇妙的地方，感受它令人驚嘆的榮耀。因此，拿起槳（或煤油燈），騎上自行車或預訂棚屋住宿，準備好探索吧。

body.en: With over 2,000 natural stone arches, not to mention teetering rocks, soaring pinnacles, and an endless array of “fins” (vertical rock walls that have been naturally eroded), it’s easy to see why Arches National Park draws more than 1.5 million people annually. Considered one of Utah’s “Big Five,” a national park collection that also includes Zion, Canyonlands, Bryce Canyon, and Capital Reef, Arches is a nature lover’s playground. You might find yourself mountain biking Slickrock one day, and squeezing through a maze of thin slot canyons the next. But while the park’s more iconic features, like its fiery red Delicate Arch, are known to many, the Arches area also features less familiar landscapes and curious activities (ever heard of “highlining”?) that will surprise, delight and open your eyes to a whole new world of adventure. Ready to go?
body.zh: 拱門國家公園擁有 2,000 多個天然石拱門，更不用說搖搖欲墜的岩石、高聳的尖峰和無盡的「鰭」（自然侵蝕的垂直岩壁），因此很容易理解為什麼拱門國家公園每年吸引超過 150 萬人。拱門被認為是猶他州「五巨頭」國家公園之一，其中還包括錫安、峽谷地、布萊斯峽谷和首都礁，是自然愛好者的遊樂場。您可能有一天會在 Slickrock 上騎山地車，第二天就會擠過迷宮般的狹縫峽谷。儘管公園更具標誌性的特色，如火紅的精緻拱門，已為許多人所熟知，但拱門區域也有一些不太熟悉的景觀和好奇的活動（聽說過“高空滑索”嗎？），它們會給您帶來驚喜、愉悅，並讓您大開眼界，進入一個全新的冒險世界。準備好了嗎？

body.en: Overflowing with dramatic mountain views, glacier-fed lakes and a mesmerizing array of wildlife, Wyoming’s second-largest national park offers something to see, do and experience around every turn. The park is named for its tallest peak, 13,755-foot-high Grand Teton, which rises over 7,000 feet above Jackson Hole, the park’s lodging and restaurant basecamp. It’s also just a 10-minute drive from Yellowstone’s south entrance, though this 310,000-acre expanse is an entity all its own. Whether it’s spotting a grizzly sow and her cubs in their natural habitat, finding yourself precariously perched on a rock face secured by a pair of carabiners and a steel cable, or embarking on a horse-drawn winter sleigh ride among thousands of elk, opportunities for adventure in the greater Grand Teton area abound. From fat biking through the snow to rafting some of the most extreme waves on the Snake River, prepare to experience the region’s most thrilling offerings.
body.zh: 懷俄明州第二大國家公園擁有壯麗的山景、冰川湖泊和一系列令人著迷的野生動物，每個角落都有值得觀賞、活動和體驗的景點。該公園因其最高峰大提頓峰而得名，該山峰高 13,755 英尺，海拔超過公園住宿和餐廳大本營傑克遜霍爾 (Jackson Hole) 7,000 英尺。儘管這片佔地 31 萬英畝的土地自成一體，但距離黃石公園南入口僅 10 分鐘車程。無論是在自然棲息地看到一頭灰熊母豬和她的幼崽，發現自己搖搖欲墜地棲息在由一對登山扣和一根鋼纜固定的岩石表面上，還是在數千隻麋鹿中乘坐馬拉的冬季雪橇，大提頓地區的冒險機會比比皆是。從在雪地裡騎寬胎自行車到在蛇河上漂流一些最極端的波浪，準備好體驗該地區最刺激的活動。

body.en: The food of Buffalo, New York, is undoubtedly bold, and locals take the city’s signature dishes as seriously as they do their devotion to the Bills. While Buffalo may be best known for its chicken wings—tossed in a mixture of butter and Frank’s Red Hot, and served always with Blue Cheese, not ranch—it’s full of other city-specific specialties that are just as thrilling and filling. And each dish has a story to tell. Beef on Weck,a roast beef sandwich topped with horseradish and served on a salted, caraway-studded roll, started just as the Buffalo wing did: a creative bar snack to fill stomachs. Pepperoni pizza in Buffalo takes everything to the extreme, from the chew of the crust and the char of the ’roni to the toppings that spread out all the way to the pie's edges. The sweets here are also turbocharged: Think super-size donuts and otherworldly candy. Below, we’ve designed the ultimate tour through Buffalo’s special dishes. Bring along your appetite.
body.zh: 紐約州布法羅的美食無疑是大膽的，當地人對待這座城市的招牌菜餚就像對待比爾一樣認真。雖然布法羅最著名的可能是雞翅——拌入黃油和弗蘭克紅辣醬的混合物，並且總是搭配藍紋奶酪，而不是牧場——但它還有其他城市特有的特色菜，同樣令人興奮和充實。每道菜都有一個故事要說。 Beef on Weck 是一種烤牛肉三明治，上面撒上辣根，放在撒有香菜的鹹味麵包卷上，它的開頭與水牛城雞翅一樣：一種填飽肚子的創意酒吧小吃。布法羅的意大利辣香腸披薩將一切發揮到了極致，從皮的咀嚼和“roni”的焦味，到一直延伸到餡餅邊緣的配料。這裡的糖果也非常豐富：想想超大號的甜甜圈和超凡脫俗的糖果。下面，我們設計了水牛城特色菜餚的終極之旅。帶上你的胃口。

body.en: West Virginia is known for its natural beauty, stunning state parks, and iconic country roads. But don’t sleep on the Mountain State’s food scene. With legendary comfort food, kitschy hot dog stands, and spots serving up extraordinary international cuisine, West Virginia is a dream destination for foodies. Start your journey in the southwest corner of the state, where you’ll find award-winning hot dogs and a side of nostalgia at Morrison’s Drive-Inn. In the state’s opposite pocket, Alma Bea serves up inventive Appalachian-inspired tapas, mouthwatering fried chicken, and lots more. In between, discover an authentic Italian bakery known for its signature pepperoni rolls, a mammoth specialty hot dog that (if wolfed in record time) earns the diner a free T-shirt, and an authentic Swiss restaurant with homemade sausage.
body.zh: 西維吉尼亞州以其自然美景、令人驚嘆的州立公園和標誌性的鄉村道路而聞名。但不要對山州的美食不滿足。西維吉尼亞州擁有傳奇般的爽心美食、俗氣的熱狗攤和提供非凡國際美食的場所，是美食家的夢想目的地。從州的西南角開始您的旅程，在那裡您可以在 Morrison’s Drive-Inn 找到屢獲殊榮的熱狗和懷舊之情。在州的另一邊，阿爾瑪比 (Alma Bea) 供應創意十足的阿巴拉契亞風味小吃、令人垂涎的炸雞等等。其間，您可以探索一家正宗的意大利麵包店，以其招牌意大利辣香腸捲而聞名，還有一個巨大的特色熱狗（如果在創紀錄的時間內狼吞虎咽），食客將獲得一件免費 T 卹，還有一家供應自製香腸的正宗瑞士餐廳。

body.en: Odds are, sooner or later, avid travelers will find themselves flying to or through Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International, the world’s most traveled airport. Serving over 100 million passengers and more than 750,000 flights annually, it’s a marvel. But wayfarers focused on getting from point A to point B might miss the treasures around the main attraction, namely a host of art, restaurants, museums, oddities and more. Here are some things you shouldn’t miss in the ATL Airport District.
body.zh: 狂熱的旅客遲早會發現自己飛往或途經哈茲菲爾德-傑克遜亞特蘭大國際機場，這是世界上旅客最多的機場。每年為超過 1 億名乘客和超過 75 萬個航班提供服務，這真是一個奇蹟。但專注於從 A 點到 B 點的徒步旅行者可能會錯過主要景點周圍的寶藏，即大量的藝術品、餐廳、博物館、奇特物品等等。以下是 ATL 機場區不容錯過的一些景點。

body.en: Nestled by the Santa Ynez Mountains on California’s rugged coastline, Santa Barbara is the perfect destination for a road trip. The historic city has something for everyone: amazing restaurants, a vibrant art scene, and plenty of wilderness for the whole family to explore. In a single day you might indulge your curiosity on a fossil-digging expedition, stroll through fields of native flowers at the Santa Barbara Botanic Garden, and split a wood-fired pizza in the Funk Zone art district. Or head down to the beach, where budding oceanographers can search tide pools for starfish, snails, and anemones, and maybe even spot a whale or a dolphin on the horizon. But whatever you do, be sure to take the scenic route, and take the time to pull over and take in the wonder the American Riviera has to offer.
body.zh: 聖塔芭芭拉坐落在加州崎嶇海岸線上的聖伊內斯山脈旁，是公路旅行的完美目的地。這座歷史悠久的城市適合每個人：令人驚嘆的餐廳、充滿活力的藝術場景以及適合全家人探索的大量荒野。在一天之內，您可能會在化石挖掘探險中滿足自己的好奇心，在聖巴巴拉植物園的本土花卉田中漫步，並在 Funk Zone 藝術區切一份木烤披薩。或前往海灘，初露頭角的海洋學家可以在潮汐池中尋找海星、蝸牛和海葵，甚至可能在地平線上發現鯨魚或海豚。但無論您做什麼，一定要走風景優美的路線，並花時間停下來欣賞美國裡維埃拉的奇觀。

body.en: Chattanooga is a vibrant, varied, and welcoming city. It’s also home to a wonderfully diverse food scene. From small, family-owned eateries that serve up inventive spins on traditional dishes to restaurants dishing out classic Southern cuisine, globally inspired fare, and vegan entrees, the choices are seemingly endless. Let these 12 restaurants and their suggested dishes be just the beginning of a deep dive into Chattanooga’s incredible culinary offerings.
body.zh: 查塔努加是一座充滿活力、多元且熱情好客的城市。這裡也是極其多樣化的美食場所的所在地。從提供創意傳統菜餚的小型家庭餐館，到提供經典南方美食、全球風味美食和純素主菜的餐廳，選擇似乎無窮無盡。讓這 12 家餐廳及其推薦菜餚只是深入了解查塔努加令人難以置信的美食的開始。

body.en: It’s not hard to find a great meal in New Orleans. Every neighborhood—from Carrollton to the Bywater and across the river into the Westbank—is teeming with restaurants, bakeries, and bars, all serving up something they call their own, all contributing to this great symbiosis of flavors and cultures we call Southern cuisine. So the trick isn’t in finding places to visit, eat, and drink while here, it’s in deciding which places out of an overabundance of options. Do you trace the roots of Creole and Cajun cooking, or seek out the flavors of global diasporas spread across the city? Do you sit for a multi-course tasting, or do you dig into neighborhood dives, cultish in their fandom, where everything is handed over in to-go containers? The spectrum of dining in New Orleans is as diverse and exciting as the city itself. Here is but a small offering of all there is to explore—consider it more of a culinary snapshot of a city in constant flux than a best-of list. You’ll find James Beard nominees and previous winners to neighborhood diners, soul food favorites, and punk rock outposts in Algiers Point, plus some of the best Thai food this side of the Mekong. If there’s a prevailing sentiment here, it’s that of community, of meals shared and cultures crossed, of service in all its manifest forms, and of how food can be a catalyst for all these things. In New Orleans, love and togetherness are woven into the city, shared over and over again, one great meal at a time.
body.zh: 在新奧爾良找到一頓美餐並不難。每個社區——從卡羅爾頓到濱水區，再到河對岸的西岸——都擠滿了餐廳、麵包店和酒吧，所有這些都提供他們自己的東西，所有這些都為我們稱之為南方美食的風味和文化的偉大共生做出了貢獻。因此，關鍵不在於找到在這裡參觀、吃飯和喝酒的地方，而是從過多的選擇中決定去哪些地方。您是否追尋克里奧爾和卡真烹飪的根源，或尋找遍布整個城市的全球僑民的風味？您是坐下來品嚐多道菜，還是深入社區潛水，崇拜他們的粉絲圈，那裡的所有東西都裝在外帶容器中？新奧爾良的餐飲種類與這座城市本身一樣多樣化且令人興奮。這裡只是提供了所有值得探索的一小部分 - 與其說它是最好的清單，不如說它是一個不斷變化的城市的烹飪快照。您可以在阿爾及爾角找到詹姆斯·比爾德提名者和之前的獲獎者，這裡有鄰裡食客、靈魂美食和朋克搖滾前哨，還有湄公河沿岸的一些最好的泰國美食。如果這裡有一種普遍的情緒，那就是社區、共享膳食和跨文化、各種形式的服務，以及食物如何成為所有這些事情的催化劑。在新奧爾良，愛與團結融入了這座城市，人們一遍又一遍地分享，一次一頓美餐。

body.en: Sure, Bangkok’s gilded temples will leave a lasting impression, but the best way to get to know the Thai capital is through your stomach. In this high-octane city, eating is a national sport, a dawn-to-way-after-dusk pastime that has shaped its infrastructure throughout the centuries. Major roads and neighborhoods have evolved around wet markets and street food hubs; modern food courts and fine-dining restaurants now take over prime real estate. Poke your head down any random soi (alleyway), and you’re almost guaranteed to find a sidewalk vendor slinging skewers of grilled meat, noodle soup, or fiery som tum (papaya salad). Bangkok’s most emblematic eats offer more than a tasty lunch—they tell stories of royal heritage; economic boom times; and centuries of migration from China, India, and beyond. Timeworn mom-and-pop restaurants still cook up recipes that have remained virtually unchanged for generations, while a new crop of young Thai chefs has started remixing these traditions with bold, innovative swagger. Below, we’ve picked 11 restaurants, food stalls, and drinking dens that capture the city’s multi-layered culinary identity, from decades-old Chinatown stalwarts to achingly hip small-plate diners. Think of this collection as a starting point for your food crawl, not a definitive list of Bangkok’s best. Because in a city where even a humble street cart can serve up an unforgettable meal, the best bowl of noodles is almost always the one right in front of you.
body.zh: 當然，曼谷的鍍金寺廟會給人留下深刻的印象，但了解泰國首都的最佳方式是透過您的胃。在這座充滿活力的城市，飲食是一項全民運動，是一種從黎明到黃昏的消遣方式，幾個世紀以來一直影響著這座城市的基礎設施。主要道路和社區圍繞著菜市場和街頭食品中心發展；現代美食廣場和高級餐廳現在佔據了黃金地段。隨便把頭伸進任何小巷，你幾乎肯定會發現路邊小販在賣烤肉串、湯麵或火辣的 som tum（木瓜沙拉）。曼谷最具代表性的美食不僅提供美味的午餐，還講述著皇家遺產的故事；經濟繁榮時期；以及來自中國、印度和其他國家的幾個世紀的移民。陳舊的夫妻餐廳仍然烹製幾代人幾乎沒有改變的食譜，而新一代的年輕泰國廚師已經開始以大膽、創新的方式重新融合這些傳統。下面，我們精選了 11 家餐廳、大排檔和酒吧，它們體現了這座城市的多層次烹飪特色，從擁有數十年歷史的唐人街老牌餐廳到極其時尚的小盤小餐館。將此系列視為您美食之旅的起點，而不是曼谷最佳美食的明確清單。因為在一個即使是一輛簡陋的街車也能提供令人難忘的一餐的城市，最好的一碗麵條幾乎總是在你面前。

body.en: For decades, Roman gastro-itineraries revolved around the same old set pieces: cappuccinos at Sant’ Eustachio Il Caffè, fried artichokes at Piperno, Berniniesque swirls of gelato at Giolitti on Piazza Navona. They’re all still there, frozen in some eternal Grand Tour glow (and besieged by tourists). But since the start of the 21st century, a new generation of passionate chefs, bakers, and gelato-makers have been updating classics with stellar ingredients and sharp attention to detail. Luckily, cucina romana never lost its brash gritty character—worlds away from the baroque, Arab-inspired cuisine of Sicily or the opulent butter-and-egg-fueled cooking of Piedmont and Emilia-Romagna. In part, Rome’s distinct food identity stems from the fact that, until it became the capital of unified Italy in 1870, the city was split into two worlds: the Vatican with its wealth, formality, and ceremonious banquets; and the popolino (common folk), who merely subsisted while the papal state feasted. The Eternal City’s cuisine has also been influenced by the rustic pastoral traditions of the surrounding regions like Abruzzo and Lazio. True to these vernacular roots, both old and new osterie and trattorie in Rome stubbornly cling to a roster of populist cucina povera classics. Invariably, there is the triumvirate of guanciale-based pasta sauces—carbonara, amatriciana, and gricia—plus cacio e pepe (senza guanciale). And certainly quinto quarto (that’s offal), ranging from tripe in tomato sauce to far more graphic innards. Winter means puntarelle, spring brings favas and artichokes. Romans eat gnocchi on Thursday, salt cod on Friday—and abbacchio (roast baby lamb) around Easter. On such certainties does Roman dining rest. But with some 30 million visitors expected to descend on the Eternal City for its Jubilee Year, how to uncover true gems amid the glut of checkered-tablecloth tourist traps? Read on! From a porchetta sandwich den lost in a time warp near Termini Station to the creamiest pistachio gelato in the district of Prati, from authentic Roman–Jewish cuisine in Trastevere to a perfect new pizzeria by Circo Massimo, we’ve curated a list of places that show off cucina romana at its eternal best.
body.zh: 幾十年來，羅馬的美食之旅都圍繞著同樣的老套路：Sant’Eustachio Il Caffè 的卡布奇諾、Piperno 的炸洋薊、納沃納廣場 Giolitti 的貝尼尼式冰淇淋漩渦。它們都還在那裡，凍結在永恆的大巡遊光芒中（並被遊客圍困）。但自 21 世紀初以來，新一代充滿熱情的廚師、麵包師和冰淇淋製作者一直在用一流的原料和對細節的敏銳關注來更新經典。幸運的是，cucina romana 從未失去其粗獷的性格——與西西里島的巴洛克風格、阿拉伯風格的美食或皮埃蒙特和艾米利亞-羅馬涅的豐盛的黃油和雞蛋烹飪截然不同。在某種程度上，羅馬獨特的食物特徵源於這樣一個事實：在 1870 年成為統一的意大利的首都之前，這座城市被分成了兩個世界：梵蒂岡，擁有財富、正式和隆重的宴會；而羅馬，則擁有財富、禮儀和隆重的宴會。還有波波利諾（popolino）（一般民眾），他們在教皇國的盛宴中勉強維持生計。這座永恆之城的美食也受到阿布魯佐和拉齊奧等周邊地區鄉村田園傳統的影響。忠於這些鄉土根源，羅馬的新舊餐廳和小餐館都頑固地堅持民粹主義的 cucina povera 經典名錄。總是有三巨頭以 guanciale 為基礎的義大利麵醬——carbonara、amatriciana 和 gricia——加上 cacio e pepe (senza guanciale)。當然還有 quinto quarto（即內臟），從番茄醬牛肚到更生動的內臟。冬天意味著蓬塔雷勒，春天則帶來蠶豆和朝鮮薊。羅馬人在星期四吃麵疙瘩，週五吃鹹鱈魚，在復活節前後吃 abbacchio（烤小羊肉）。羅馬餐飲就建立在這種確定性之上。但預計將有約 3000 萬遊客來到這座永恆之城慶祝禧年，如何在眾多格紋桌布旅遊陷阱中發現真正的瑰寶呢？繼續閱讀！從特米尼火車站附近迷失在時間扭曲中的烤乳酪三明治店到普拉蒂區最奶油的開心果冰淇淋，從特拉斯提弗列的正宗羅馬猶太美食到 Circo Massimo 的完美新披薩店，我們精心策劃了一份展示 cucina romana 永恆最佳狀態的餐廳清單。

body.en: While it might not be the first place that comes to mind when asked about bucket-list destinations, northern Michigan is no stranger to visitors. In-the-know “resorters”—as seasonal residents were called at the turn of the last century—have been flocking to this bucolic, rural region to escape the summertime heat of Chicago, Detroit, Cincinnati, Fort Wayne, and other Midwestern cities for generations. Part of the allure of any trip “Up North,” as the northern swath of Michigan’s lower peninsula is known, is to retreat to a bygone era long before cell phones and laptops—a time when the lakeside communities that sit near the 45th parallel halfway between the equator and the North Pole were mining for copper or iron, a time when those wealthy resorters arrived by steamship, train, or Model T. Just as those early travelers were escaping the heat, modern visitors deserve to escape hustle, and there is no better place to do so than certain iconic, nostalgia-steeped stops that remain suspended in time. That includes a fifth-generation fishing shanty where you can grab smoked whitefish to take home, the still-operating printing press of a beloved mid-century nature artist, and a lakeside cabin that’s served a Polish immigrant’s family recipes for 100 years.
body.zh: 雖然當被問及願望清單目的地時，它可能不是第一個想到的地方，但密西根州北部對遊客來說並不陌生。幾個世代以來，知情的「度假者」（上世紀之交對季節性居民的稱呼）紛紛湧入這個充滿田園風光的鄉村地區，以躲避芝加哥、底特律、辛辛那提、韋恩堡和其他中西部城市的夏季炎熱。 「向北」（密西根州下半島的北部地區被稱為「北上」）旅行的部分吸引力在於，您可以回到手機和筆記型電腦出現之前很久的舊時代——那時，位於赤道和北極之間的北緯 45 度線附近的湖濱社區正在開採銅或鐵，那些富有的度假者乘坐輪船、火車或 T 型車抵達這裡。就像那些早期的旅客逃離炎熱一樣，現代遊客也值得逃離喧囂，沒有比某些標誌性的、充滿懷舊氣息的停留點更好的地方了。其中包括第五代的漁棚，您可以在那裡抓到熏白魚帶回家；由一位深受喜愛的中世紀自然藝術家設計的仍在運轉的印刷機；以及一間湖邊小屋，100 年來一直為波蘭移民提供家庭食譜。

body.en: The best road trips are those that seem to take you to new worlds: surreal-looking beaches, wondrous parks, and roadside oddities that make you do a double take. For instance, in Wisconsin, a local plumber has rigged a natural aquifer into a series of ice sculptures; in Utah, erosion has created a series of rock formations that look like something between an army of goblins and a series of abstract landscapes; and in New Mexico, rippling white sands stretch out to the horizon as far as the eye can see. The best part? You can reach these—and eight more—places by car (with the occasional walk from the parking lot). So pack some snacks, pull up this itinerary, and hit the road.
body.zh: 最好的公路旅行是那些似乎能帶你進入新世界的旅行：超現實的海灘、奇妙的公園，以及讓你回味無窮的路邊奇景。例如，在威斯康辛州，當地的水管工將天然含水層安裝成一系列冰雕；在猶他州，侵蝕形成了一系列岩層，看起來像是一群妖精和一系列抽象景觀之間的東西；在新墨西哥州，白色的沙子泛起漣漪，一直延伸到地平線，一望無際。最好的部分？您可以開車到達這些地點以及另外八個地點（偶爾從停車場步行）。所以帶上一些零食，拉起這個行程，上路吧。

body.en: One of the greatest features of the United States is its rich, varied collection of national parks. From the mountains of the Colorado, to the California desert, to Maine’s craggy coast, these diverse landscapes offer wild nature, staggering vistas, and endless opportunity for adventure. And while many are famous for their hiking trails, there are also plenty of parks across the country with beautiful scenic drives that let you see more of the park in a single day. Here, we’ve collected the best national parks for driving, whether you’re hankering for a Blue Ridge road trip or a desert adventure. And if you need to stretch your legs, don’t worry: here, the pit stops are half the fun.
body.zh: 美國最大的特色之一是其豐富多樣的國家公園。從科羅拉多州的山脈，到加州的沙漠，再到緬因州崎嶇的海岸，這些多樣化的景觀提供了野生自然、令人驚嘆的景色和無盡的冒險機會。雖然許多公園以其遠足小徑而聞名，但全國各地也有許多公園擁有美麗的風景駕車道，讓您在一天之內遊覽更多公園。在這裡，我們收集了最適合開車的國家公園，無論您是渴望藍嶺公路旅行還是沙漠冒險。如果您需要伸展雙腿，請不要擔心：在這裡，進站就是一半的樂趣。

body.en: The world still doesn’t quite know what to make of Appalachia. The mountainous, multi-state region has long been defined both by mystery and misconceptions. In many ways, it’s been America’s shadow since the nation’s birth. Early settlers fretted about American Indian tribes, dark hollows, and looming wilderness in the 1600s and 1700s, while modern folks tend to worry more about the environmental degradation and concentration of Trump voters. Yet, Appalachia is much like America as a whole—it sprawls from south to north across several states, spawning local cultures marked as much by their diversity and differences than what they have in common. And these mountains are old. Rocks formed during the Precambrian era have been found in some places. Parts of the Appalachian Mountains are thought to be even older than Saturn’s rings, and millennia of erosion have given rise to one of the richest temperate ecosystems in the world. This diverse bioregion has become home to a melting pot of culture. Archaeological findings indicate that American Indian tribes inhabited the region 20,000 years ago. The first Europeans arrived in the 1500s, when Spanish conquistadors ventured up from what is now Florida. English and French settlers followed, establishing a general pattern that continues into the present: Newcomers bring their cultural traditions into the region, where they are absorbed into the greater whole.
body.zh: 世界仍然不太清楚該如何看待阿巴拉契亞。長期以來，這個多州多山的地區一直充滿神秘感和誤解。從很多方面來說，自美國誕生以來，它一直是美國的影子。早期定居者對 1600 年代和 1700 年代的美洲印第安部落、黑暗的山谷和迫在眉睫的荒野感到擔憂，而現代人則往往更擔心環境惡化和川普選民的集中。然而，阿巴拉契亞很像整個美國——它從南到北橫跨幾個州，孕育了當地文化，其多樣性和差異性比它們的共同點還要多。而且這些山很古老。在一些地方發現了前寒武紀形成的岩石。阿巴拉契亞山脈的部分地區被認為比土星環還要古老，數千年的侵蝕催生了世界上最豐富的溫帶生態系統之一。這個多樣化的生物區已成為文化熔爐。考古發現表明，兩萬年前美洲印第安部落就居住在該地區。第一批歐洲人於 1500 年代抵達，當時西班牙征服者從現在的佛羅裡達州冒險而來。英國和法國定居者緊隨其後，建立了延續至今的整體模式：新移民將他們的文化傳統帶入該地區，在那裡他們被吸收到更大的整體中。

body.en: Highway 61 is known as “The Blues Highway” as it makes its way from New Orleans to Memphis, following the Mississippi River through lands forged over eons, from the coastal swamps of Louisiana to the alluvial plains of the Delta, the highway connecting these landscapes to the human tales etched into the soil, telling the story of the Deep South through a journey of migration, transformation, and enduring spirit. In New Orleans, where I was born and raised, Highway 61 was the end of my known world. It was a road of short-stay motels, pawn shops, Bingo parlors, and a pervading sense of danger. It was the boundary of my childhood, of all that was safe and familiar. Years later, as an adult, I would come to know the highway as a conduit to the past, an artery of profound historical and cultural significance, invention and reinvention, of human dreams pinned to its asphalt, ever following the river like an acolyte to the great hand that carved both into the mythos of the South.
body.zh: 61 號公路被稱為“藍調公路”，因為它從新奧爾良到孟菲斯，沿著密西西比河穿過億萬年形成的土地，從路易斯安那州的沿海沼澤到三角洲的沖積平原，這條公路將這些景觀與銘刻在土壤中的人類故事連接起來，通過移民、轉變和持久精神的旅程講述了南方腹地的故事。在我出生長大的新奧爾良，61 號高速公路是我已知世界的盡頭。這條路佈滿了短期住宿汽車旅館、當舖、賓果遊戲店，瀰漫著一種危險的感覺。這是我童年的邊界，是安全和熟悉的一切的邊界。多年後，作為一個成年人，我逐漸認識到這條高速公路是通往過去的通道，是一條具有深遠歷史和文化意義、發明和重塑的動脈，是釘在柏油路上的人類夢想的動脈，它永遠沿著河流而行，就像那把兩者都雕刻成南方神話的巨手的追隨者一樣。

body.en: Think London, and it’s likely you’ll picture a cozy pub. The word is a 17th-century abbreviation of the term “public house,” a concept originally inspired by Roman-era taverns, but the pub as we know it today is one of the most quintessentially British and Irish cultural icons, with its own unique aesthetic and culture. Much has been written about the fact that pubs in the United Kingdom and Ireland are dying; a 2023 government report shared that, every day in England and Wales, two pubs close their doors. Even the pubs in a modern, ever-evolving city like London can feel like a glimpse into a disappearing past. Much has also been written about London’s oldest pubs, but we wanted to share a collection of pubs with links to contemporary music, British food, literature, interior design, architecture, and, of course, great beer, rather than just age.
body.zh: 想想倫敦，您很可能會想到一家舒適的酒吧。這個詞是 17 世紀「酒館」一詞的縮寫，這個概念最初受到羅馬時代小酒館的啟發，但我們今天所知道的酒吧是最典型的英國和愛爾蘭文化標誌之一，擁有自己獨特的美學和文化。關於英國和愛爾蘭的酒吧正在消亡的事實已經有很多文章了。 2023 年的政府報告顯示，在英格蘭和威爾士，每天都有兩家酒吧關門。即使是像倫敦這樣現代化、不斷發展的城市裡的酒吧也會讓人感覺像是瞥見了正在消失的過去。關於倫敦最古老的酒吧也有很多文章，但我們想分享一系列與當代音樂、英國美食、文學、室內設計、建築，當然還有美味啤酒有關的酒吧，而不僅僅是年齡。

body.en: Joshua Tree may be known for attracting crowds of social influencers and visitors unfamiliar with national park etiquette. Yet despite the reputation, it remains at its core a mystical place. Its ancient landscape is dotted with fuzzy cacti, sculptural rock formations, and the namesake Joshua trees—which aren’t trees at all, but a species of yucca that can live for centuries in the Mojave Desert. The otherworldly setting has drawn generations of soul-seekers, avant-garde artists, and others who march to the beat of their own drums. Today, you can embark on an unconventional adventure, encountering everything from a spiritual center dedicated to the “science of the future” to a geodesic dome purportedly inspired by extraterrestrials. Plan your next adventure with our Explorer’s Guide to the Parks.
body.zh: 約書亞樹可能因吸引大量社會影響者和不熟悉國家公園禮儀的遊客而聞名。然而，儘管享有盛譽，它的核心仍然是一個神秘的地方。其古老的景觀點綴著毛茸茸的仙人掌、雕塑般的岩層和同名的約書亞樹——它們根本不是樹，而是一種可以在莫哈韋沙漠中生存數百年的絲蘭。這種超凡脫俗的環境吸引了一代又一代的靈魂探索者、前衛藝術家和其他按自己的步調前進的人。今天，您可以踏上非傳統的冒險之旅，邂逅從致力於「未來科學」的精神中心到據稱受外星人啟發的測地圓頂的一切。使用我們的公園探險家指南來規劃您的下一次冒險。

body.en: The Great Smoky Mountains National Park sprawls over more than half a million acres of some of the eastern United States’ tallest peaks and wildest lands. Its central location and diversity of life and landscapes make it Appalachia’s premier destination. The Smokies encompasses the North Carolina/Tennessee border, bisected by nearly 72 miles of the Appalachian Trail. The park is home to soaring vistas, hidden hollows, sparkling waterways, the remains of historic settlements, and an abundance of wildlife that includes black bear, elk, and other species. Indeed, the Smokies is easily the most visited national park in the United States (although it falls behind Golden Gate National Recreation Area and the Blue Ridge Parkway for as the National Park Service’s most visited site), with more than 12 million visitors in 2024 alone. The park’s sheer size and variety of access points allow visitors who plan ahead to find plenty of peace and solitude even during the Smokies’ busiest season. Plan your next adventure with our Explorer’s Guide to the Parks.
body.zh: 大煙山國家公園佔地超過 50 萬英畝，是美國東部一些最高的山峰和最荒涼的土地。它的中心位置以及多樣化的生活和景觀使其成為阿巴拉契亞的首要目的地。大霧山環繞北卡羅來納州/田納西州邊界，被近 72 英里的阿巴拉契亞小徑一分為二。公園擁有高聳的遠景、隱密的山谷、波光粼粼的水道、歷史定居點的遺跡以及豐富的野生動物，包括黑熊、麋鹿和其他物種。事實上，大霧山無疑是美國訪問量最大的國家公園（儘管作為國家公園管理局訪問量最大的地點，它落後於金門國家遊樂區和藍嶺公園大道），僅 2024 年就有超過 1200 萬遊客。公園的巨大規模和各種接入點讓提前規劃的遊客即使在大霧山最繁忙的季節也能找到充足的寧靜和孤獨。使用我們的公園探險家指南來規劃您的下一次冒險。

body.en: It’s tough to measure awe, but we’ll give it a shot. Imagine jaw-dropping views of stars, planets, flying meteors, and other celestial wonders illuminating the night sky over a rugged mountainscape. In Colorado, you can see all of this and more at one of its many Dark Sky places. For anyone entranced by the wonders of stargazing, the state has nearly ten percent of the world’s Dark Sky Parks and Communities, places untouched by light pollution. To put it another way, Colorado boasts nearly 300,000 acres of dreamy campgrounds, gleaming waterways, and beaches beneath star-freckled skies. That’s a lifetime of awe right there. So what makes the Centennial State so perfect for stargazing? Thank the high altitude, remote towns, and wide-open landscapes. All those ingredients ensure vivid views of the universe beyond. Then, of course, there are the landscapes. From the sprawling sand dunes of the San Luis Valley, to the ancient cliff dwellings of the desert southwest, the state is covered in picture-perfect backdrops. Consider the Colorado sky your silver screen, and these nine destinations your front-row seats to the show of a lifetime. Here are some of the best places to stargaze in Colorado.
body.zh: 敬畏感很難衡量，但我們會試試看。想像一下，星星、行星、飛行的流星和其他天體奇觀照亮了崎嶇山地的夜空，令人驚嘆不已。在科羅拉多州，您可以在眾多黑暗天空地點之一看到所有這些以及更多。對於那些對觀星奇觀著迷的人來說，該州擁有世界上近百分之十的暗夜公園和社區，這些地方都沒有受到光污染的影響。換句話說，科羅拉多州擁有近 30 萬英畝的夢幻露營地、閃閃發光的水道以及佈滿星星的天空下的海灘。那是一生的敬畏。那麼是什麼讓百年州如此適合觀星呢？感謝這裡的高海拔、偏遠的城鎮和廣闊的風景。所有這些成分確保了對遠處宇宙的生動觀察。當然，還有風景。從聖路易斯山谷廣闊的沙丘，到西南沙漠的古老懸崖住宅，該州被風景如畫的背景所覆蓋。將科羅拉多州的天空視為您的銀幕，將這九個目的地視為您一生難忘的演出的前排座位。以下是科羅拉多州最好的觀星地點。

body.en: Sharp stone peaks, hulking glaciers, and iridescent blue lakes have long made Canada’s first national park its most visited. Nearly the entire Rocky Mountain range in Canada is covered by a string of national parks smushed together, so the wilderness here feels as vast as the northern country itself. That raw ruggedness is exactly what’s been attracting people for hundreds of years, so the land is pocketed with nuggets of history. Many people are familiar with the icefields, hot springs, skiing, and hiking in Banff. But not as many are aware of the mummified merman, rare translucent cave creatures, a sunken ghost town that requires scuba diving to the bottom of a lake, or the old swinger restaurant that keeps the area colorful with quirky stories. From the town of Banff to the point where the road seamlessly passes into next-door Jasper National Park, here are the attention-grabbing sites and legendary tales of Banff National Park in Canada’s wild west. Plan your next adventure with our Explorer’s Guide to the Parks.
body.zh: 尖銳的石峰、巨大的冰川和彩虹色的藍色湖泊長期以來使加拿大第一個國家公園成為最受歡迎的國家公園。加拿大的整個落基山脈幾乎都被一連串的國家公園所覆蓋，因此這裡的荒野感覺就像北方國家本身一樣廣闊。數百年來，這種原始的崎嶇正是吸引人們的地方，因此這片土地上蘊藏著豐富的歷史財富。很多人都熟悉班夫的冰原、溫泉、滑雪、健行。但很少人知道木乃伊人魚、罕見的半透明洞穴生物、需要水肺潛水到湖底的沉沒鬼城，或是讓該地區充滿離奇故事的古老搖擺餐廳。從班夫鎮到公路無縫通入隔壁的賈斯珀國家公園，這裡有加拿大狂野西部班夫國家公園的引人注目的景點和傳奇故事。使用我們的公園探險家指南來規劃您的下一次冒險。

body.en: From the high reaches of the Appalachians to expansive underground caverns, West Virginia’s rich and varied natural landscape is full of surprises. Climb the observation tower at West Virginia’s highest peak and take in sweeping views of the vast landscape, or explore the many below-ground caves, packed with fanciful formations. In between, hike the most significant botanical area in the Appalachian region—a rare find that offers striking similarities to the arctic tundra, stand in a spot that struck awe in a U.S. President, or stay overnight in a historic fire tower as you take in the star-studded night sky. Nature lovers, set your sights on West Virginia.
body.zh: 從阿巴拉契亞山脈的高處到廣闊的地下洞穴，西維吉尼亞州豐富多樣的自然景觀充滿了驚喜。登上西維吉尼亞州最高峰的觀景塔，將廣闊的景觀盡收眼底，或探索許多充滿奇特構造的地下洞穴。其間，您可以徒步前往阿巴拉契亞地區最重要的植物區——這是一個與北極苔原有著驚人相似之處的罕見發現，站在令美國總統驚嘆不已的地方，或者在歷史悠久的消防塔中過夜，欣賞繁星密布的夜空。大自然愛好者，請將目光投向西維吉尼亞州。

body.en: There’s the version of Red Rocks most people know: the iconic open-air concert venue flanked by soaring sandstone fins. And then, there’s the version that even the amphitheater’s biggest fans sometimes overlook. Behind its impressive facade, you’ll find that the Denver-area venue has a hidden side—a quirky streak that it just might reveal to you if you know where to look. To see Red Rocks at its most pensive, go at first light. Mule deer and lynx sometimes roam the trails surrounding the amphitheater, and the sun’s first rays gild the rock until it seems to glow. Book a sunrise yoga session on the steps, or join the runners on dawn patrol: jogging the stone bleachers is a local rite of passage (and a serious workout). History buffs would be remiss not to stop into the Red Rocks Hall of Fame—a curving corridor lined with guitars and other rare artifacts—or visit the nearby Civilian Conservation Corps building that housed Red Rocks’ creators. Want to go even deeper? Singletrack trails wind through the ancient sandstone passages, unfurling a 300-million-year geology lesson one stratum at a time. That’s just a taste of what Red Rocks has in store for those willing to ferret out its secrets. Here are ten ways to uncover the whimsical, gritty, spooky, and mysterious sides of Colorado’s most iconic stage.
body.zh: 這是大多數人都知道的紅岩版本：標誌性的露天音樂會場地，兩側是高聳的砂岩鰭。還有一個版本，即使是露天劇場的鐵桿粉絲有時也會忽略。在其令人印象深刻的外觀背後，您會發現這座位於丹佛地區的場館有隱藏的一面——如果您知道去哪裡尋找，它可能會向您揭示一種古怪的特徵。要欣賞最令人沉思的紅岩，請在天亮時出發。黑尾鹿和山貓有時會在圓形劇場周圍的小路上漫步，第一縷陽光將岩石鍍上一層金色，直到它看起來閃閃發光。在台階上預訂日出瑜伽課程，或與跑步者一起進行黎明巡邏：在石頭露天看台上慢跑是當地的一種儀式（也是一項嚴肅的鍛煉）。歷史愛好者如果不去紅岩名人堂（Red Rocks Hall of Fame）——一條蜿蜒的走廊，兩旁擺放著吉他和其他稀有文物——或者參觀附近紅岩創作者居住的平民保護隊大樓，那就太失職了。想要更深入嗎？單軌小徑蜿蜒穿過古老的砂岩通道，逐層展開一堂長達 3 億年的地質課程。這只是 Red Rocks 為那些願意探索其秘密的人準備的一個嚐鮮。這裡有十種方法來揭開科羅拉多州最具標誌性舞台的異想天開、堅韌不拔、幽靈般和神秘的一面。

body.en: Williamsburg, Virginia played a pivotal role in the American Revolution and the early development of the nation, serving as a center of strong ideas and innovative thinking. Today, this legacy is firmly rooted in the past and extremely relevant to the present. From a beach brimming with the fossilized remains of extinct sea creatures to a tavern once frequented by the nation’s Founding Fathers, Virginia’s “Historic Triangle” is full of unusual finds for every type of traveler. Use this guide to inspire your next trip.
body.zh: 維吉尼亞州威廉斯堡在美國革命和國家早期發展中發揮了關鍵作用，是強大思想和創新思維的中心。今天，這一遺產牢牢紮根於過去，並且與現在息息相關。從佈滿已滅絕海洋生物化石殘骸的海灘到美國開國元勳們曾經經常光顧的小酒館，弗吉尼亞州的「歷史三角區」為各類旅行者提供了不同尋常的發現。使用本指南來激發您的下一次旅行。

body.en: With their sprawling beaches and sunny skies, the British Virgin Islands are one of the greatest destinations for those looking for an island getaway. But the fun shouldn’t stop at relaxation: across this archipelago of roughly 60 islands, adventure awaits for those intrepid enough to seek it. The pirates—who used these islands as a refuge in the 17th century—have gone, but their dauntless spirit remains. Here you can walk through an otherworldly maze of seaside boulders, or dip in a natural jacuzzi made frothy by crashing waves. Head out to sea to have a drink on a pirate ship, or get on your scuba gear to explore an underwater art exhibit. Whether your own personal treasure map leads you to food, nature, or the sea, you’re sure to strike gold on these islands. Here are the ten most exciting spots to explore.
body.zh: 英屬維京群島擁有廣闊的海灘和陽光明媚的天空，是尋求島嶼度假的人的最佳目的地之一。但樂趣不應該止步於放鬆：在這個由大約 60 個島嶼組成的群島上，冒險等待著那些勇敢的人去探索。 17 世紀將這些島嶼作為避難所的海盜已經消失，但他們無畏的精神仍然存在。在這裡，您可以漫步在海邊巨石組成的超凡脫俗的迷宮中，或浸泡在因海浪拍打而產生泡沫的天然按摩浴缸中。出海在海盜船上喝一杯，或是穿上潛水裝備探索水下藝術展。無論您自己的藏寶圖帶您前往美食、自然或大海，您都一定會在這些島嶼上淘到金子。以下是十個最令人興奮的探索景點。

body.en: Think Hong Kong and the mind flits to dim sum, sweet roasted meats, and noodles. While you’ll still find all of those in abundance here, Hong Kong’s status as a port city and a former British colony have led to dishes that exist outside of the Cantonese genre—indeed, also to entirely new cross-cultural genres.With this in mind, we wanted to put together a list that touches on the classics: a stuck-in-time dim sum hall, a streetside dai pai dong where nearly every dish is cooked in a wok, and an artisanal soy sauce maker. You’ll also find a few lesser-known places that are nonetheless important to Hong Kong’s food scene: the local equivalent of the diner, restaurants that serve Western dishes as perceived through a Chinese lens, Hong Kong’s unique bakeries, as well as things tangential to the territory’s food culture such as kitchen supplies and the neon signs that used to decorate nearly every restaurant in the city.
body.zh: 想到香港，你的腦海裡就會浮現出點心、甜烤肉和麵條。雖然你仍然會在這裡找到這些豐富的東西，但香港作為港口城市和前英國殖民地的地位催生了粵菜流派之外的菜餚，事實上，也催生了全新的跨文化流派。考慮到這一點，我們想列出一份觸及經典的清單：一家古老的點心館、一家幾乎每道菜都是用炒鍋烹製的街邊大排檔，以及一家手工醬油製造商。您還會發現一些鮮為人知的地方，但對香港的美食界很重要：相當於當地的小餐館、以中國人的視角提供西餐的餐廳、香港獨特的麵包店，以及與香港飲食文化無關的東西，例如廚房用品和過去幾乎每家餐廳裝飾的霓虹燈標誌。

body.en: If you want to explore Colorado’s wildest corners, you’ll first need to pass through Denver. Often called the gateway to the Mountain West, Denver is a portal to the rugged peaks, rolling sand dunes, and rippling aspen forests that lie beyond its doorstep. But this city isn’t just a stepping stone to adventure; it’s a worthwhile stopover in its own right. No Colorado visit is complete without a weekend in the Mile High City. Before Colorado’s national parks existed, these landscapes played host to explorers, naturalists, fur trappers, and thriving Native American nations. All these people and cultures converged in Denver, bringing maps, plant and animal specimens, and profound environmental insights with them. Over the last 175 years, that rich knowledge transfer has turned Denver into a city that is deeply connected to the natural world. Today, the Denver Museum of Nature & Science contains some of the state’s earliest animal specimens, as well as fossils from the Colorado Rockies. Botany enthusiasts will want to tour Populus, the head-turning hotel that looks like an aspen tree, or visit the Denver Botanic Gardens to learn how researchers are preserving the nation’s rarest alpine flowers. More interested in the cultural history of our national parklands? Sample traditional recipes at Tocabe, a Native American restaurant that highlights Indigenous-grown food; or grab a drink at Buckhorn Exchange, a 19th-century bar once frequented by miners, fur traders, and presidents alike. A city built by and for outdoorspeople, Denver is one of the best places on the planet to spark your curiosity before your adventure west. Here are eight of the best spots to prepare you for the outdoor experience of a lifetime.
body.zh: 如果您想探索科羅拉多州最狂野的角落，您首先需要經過丹佛。丹佛通常被稱為通往西部山區的門戶，是通往門外崎嶇山峰、起伏的沙丘和碧波蕩漾的白楊森林的門戶。但這座城市不僅是冒險的墊腳石，也是冒險的墊腳石。這本身就是一個值得停留的地方。如果沒有在英里高城度過一個週末，科羅拉多之旅就不算完整。在科羅拉多州國家公園出現之前，這些景觀曾是探險家、博物學家、毛皮捕獵者和繁榮的美洲原住民國家的家園。所有這些人和文化聚集在丹佛，帶來了地圖、動植物標本以及深刻的環境見解。在過去 175 年裡，豐富的知識轉移使丹佛成為一個與自然世界緊密相連的城市。如今，丹佛自然科學博物館收藏了該州一些最早的動物標本，以及來自科羅拉多州落基山脈的化石。植物學愛好者會想要參觀胡楊樹，這是一家看起來像白楊樹的令人驚嘆的酒店，或者參觀丹佛植物園，了解研究人員如何保護美國最稀有的高山花卉。對我們國家公園的文化歷史更感興趣嗎？在 Tocabe 品嚐傳統食譜，這是一家美國原住民餐廳，主打原住民種植的食物；或者在 Buckhorn Exchange 喝一杯，這是一家 19 世紀的酒吧，曾經是礦工、毛皮商人和總統經常光顧的地方。丹佛是一個由戶外活動人士建造並為戶外活動人士建造的城市，也是世界上最能激發您在西部探險之前激發好奇心的地方之一。這裡有八個最佳地點，可幫助您為一生難忘的戶外體驗做好準備。

body.en: Oaxaca, the mountainous state in Mexico’s south, is celebrated as the country’s “cradle of diversity.” Home to 16 Indigenous ethnic groups from Mixtecs to Triques to Zapotecs, it also boasts the country’s greatest biodiversity, counting 522 edible herbs, over 30 native agave varieties distilled by some 600 mezcal-producing facilities, 35 landraces (unique cultivars) of corn, and some two-dozen native species of chiles and beans. Oaxaca de Juárez, the state’s colonial capital, is drawing record numbers of visitors these days for its cobblestoned streets and the arty graffiti. But the main draw is Oaxaca’s status as the culinary epicenter of Mexico for its dozens of mole varieties, an encyclopedia of corn masa-based antojitos—memelas, tetelas, totopos, tlayudas, tamales—and a baroque layering of colonial-Spanish and pre-Hispanic Indigenous foodways. Local chefs understand that to be culinary authority here one must be part botanist and part anthropologist—roles which they embrace with great relish. Among the welcome recent developments to the restaurant scene has been the great rise of female chefs, as well as a new interest in cooking from the state’s different regions in addition to the complex colonial flavors of the Valles Centrales surrounding the capital. Whether you’re after unusual moles from the rugged Mixteca region, breads made exclusively from Oaxacan wheat, or a country lunch featuring edible insects, our guide has you covered. From a cult street taco stand to a Michelin-starred chef resurrecting forgotten dishes, here are the culinary highs to hit.
body.zh: 瓦哈卡州是墨西哥南部的山區，被譽為該國的「多樣性的搖籃」。這裡是米斯特克人、特里克斯人、薩巴特克人等 16 個土著民族的家園，還擁有該國最豐富的生物多樣性，擁有 522 種可食用藥草、由約 600 個梅斯卡爾生產設施蒸餾的 30 多種本土龍舌蘭品種、35 種玉米地方品種（獨特辣椒品種）以及約兩打本土辣椒品種和豆類品種。瓦哈卡德華雷斯 (Oaxaca de Juárez) 是該州的殖民首府，如今以其鵝卵石街道和藝術塗鴉吸引著創紀錄的遊客數量。但最吸引人的是瓦哈卡州作為墨西哥烹飪中心的地位，這裡有數十種摩爾品種，一部以玉米粉糊為基礎的 antojitos（memelas、tetelas、totopos、tlayudas、tamales）的百科全書，以及巴洛克風格的西班牙殖民時期和前西班牙土著飲食方式。當地廚師明白，要成為這裡的烹飪權威，一個人必須一半是植物學家，一半是人類學家──他們非常津津樂道地接受這個角色。餐廳界最近令人歡迎的發展包括女廚師的大幅崛起，以及除了首都周圍中央山谷複雜的殖民風味之外，人們對州內不同地區的烹飪產生了新的興趣。無論您是想尋找來自崎嶇的米斯特卡地區的不尋常鼴鼠、專門用瓦哈卡小麥製成的麵包，還是以可食用昆蟲為特色的鄉村午餐，我們的指南都能滿足您的需求。從街頭流行的玉米餅攤到米其林星級廚師重新演繹被遺忘的菜餚，以下是您可以體驗到的烹飪高潮。

body.en: In San Diego, a city on the sea just over the border from the coastal state of Baja California, the freshness of the food leaps off the plate, thanks to chefs who are constantly finding new ways to turn local produce and seafood into something delectable. The city’s history, heritage, and proximity to Mexico—combined with the fresh, simple flavors of California cuisine—create a cross-border culinary identity known as Cali-Baja. It’s not just a fusion, but a lifestyle rooted in variety and simplicity. While San Diego has a long and celebrated tradition of excellent Mexican food—from street tacos to aguachile—that’s just the beginning. The city’s diverse neighborhoods each bring something unique to the table: hand-pulled noodles in Convoy District, beachside burgers in Ocean Beach, artisan pasta in Little Italy, and seafood-forward small plates in La Jolla. The commitment to bold flavor and local ingredients is unmistakable. And thanks to year-round sunshine and a laid-back beach culture, great food is easy to find and even easier to enjoy. This diversity of cuisine, paired with an adventurous, open-hearted spirit, makes America’s Finest City a standout destination for curious eaters and families alike.
body.zh: 在聖地牙哥這個與下加利福尼亞州沿海州接壤的海上城市，食物的新鮮度從盤子上躍然紙上，這要歸功於廚師們不斷尋找新方法將當地農產品和海鮮變成美味佳餚。這座城市的歷史、傳統和毗鄰墨西哥的地理位置，再加上新鮮、簡單的加州美食風味，創造了一種被稱為「Cali-Baja」的跨境烹飪特色。這不僅僅是一種融合，而是一種植根於多樣性和簡單性的生活方式。雖然聖地牙哥有著悠久而著名的墨西哥美食傳統——從街頭玉米餅到阿瓜奇爾——但這只是一個開始。這座城市的多元化街區各有特色：Convoy District 的手拉麵、Ocean Beach 的海濱漢堡、Little Italy 的手工麵食以及 La Jolla 的海鮮小盤。對大膽風味和當地食材的承諾是明確無誤的。由於全年的陽光和悠閒的海灘文化，美味的食物很容易找到，甚至更容易享受。這種多樣化的美食，加上冒險、開放的精神，使美國最好的城市成為好奇的食客和家庭的絕佳目的地。

body.en: With wild horses, a small elk called a “sika,” a massive population of bald eagles, and the once-endangered fox squirrel, the state of Maryland is home to a thrilling variety of wildlife. Across diverse ecosystems like swamps, cliffs, mountains, and sandy beaches, the state springs alive during spring and summer with the sounds of birds, mammals, amphibians, and reptiles that the state has been careful to protect. Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, these parks, preserves, and protected areas across Maryland offer visitors a chance to encounter fauna they may have never even known existed.
body.zh: 馬裡蘭州擁有野馬、一種被稱為「梅花鹿」的小麋鹿、大量禿鷹以及曾經瀕臨滅絕的狐松鼠，是各種令人興奮的野生動物的家。在沼澤、懸崖、山脈和沙灘等多樣化的生態系統中，該州在春季和夏季充滿了生機，充滿了該州精心保護的鳥類、哺乳動物、兩棲動物和爬行動物的聲音。馬裡蘭州的這些公園、保護區和保護區非常適合戶外運動愛好者，為遊客提供了邂逅他們可能從未知道的動物群的機會。

body.en: How many times can a city be called a “hidden gem” before it stops being hidden? Judging by the enthusiastic throngs wandering its cobbled Baroque streets in summer, Slovenia’s capital has certainly been discovered, but perhaps by the wiser tourists. Though it is popular it is never overcrowded, and each visitor who falls for its charms (and they inevitably do) feels as though they’ve stumbled upon a secret treasure. Perhaps this lingering sense of discovery comes from its tricky-to-pronounce name (Loo-blee-ah-nah) or the fact that Slovenia only gained independence from Yugoslavia in 1991, making it feel newly accessible to many travelers. But this very quality is part of its appeal—Ljubljana is a city full of surprises. It’s unexpectedly elegant and prosperous (historically the most developed of the former Yugoslav capitals), remarkably easy to visit , impressively green (a former European Green Capital with the highest percentage of pedestrianized streets in Europe), surprisingly well-connected, and effortlessly cool. With a quarter of its 300,000-odd inhabitants being students, Ljubljana has a vibrant, youthful energy combined with refined Central European charm. Though often grouped with “Eastern Europe,” all of Slovenia actually lies west of Vienna, which was historically its greatest influence, having been part of the Habsburg Empire for centuries. The city center is compact, highly walkable, and photogenic, with minimal Socialist-era architecture disrupting its Old World atmosphere—unlike sister cities such as Belgrade. And then there’s its stunning backdrop: a 30-minute drive north, the snow-capped Alps rise majestically above the skyline. Spend just a few hours in Ljubljana, and it will come as no surprise that its name translates to “beloved.”
body.zh: 一座城市在不再被隱藏之前可以被稱為「隱藏的寶石」多少次？從夏天在巴洛克式鵝卵石街道上漫步的熱情人群來看，斯洛維尼亞的首都肯定已經被發現，但也許是被更聰明的遊客發現的。雖然它很受歡迎，但從來沒有人滿為患，每一個被它的魅力所吸引的遊客（他們不可避免地會這樣做）都會感覺好像他們偶然發現了一個秘密寶藏。也許這種揮之不去的發現感來自於它難以發音的名字（Loo-blee-ah-nah），或者來自斯洛維尼亞於 1991 年才從南斯拉夫獨立出來的事實，這讓許多旅行者感覺這裡煥然一新。但這種特質正是其吸引力的一部分——盧布爾雅那是一座充滿驚喜的城市。它出乎意料地優雅和繁榮（歷史上是前南斯拉夫首都中最發達的），非常容易參觀，令人印象深刻的綠色（前歐洲綠色之都，擁有歐洲步行街比例最高的），令人驚訝的四通八達，而且毫不費力地很酷。盧布爾雅那的 30 多萬名居民中有四分之一是學生，盧布爾雅那充滿活力、青春活力，與精緻的中歐魅力相結合。雖然斯洛維尼亞經常被歸類為“東歐”，但實際上整個斯洛維尼亞都位於維也納以西，維也納歷史上對斯洛維尼亞影響最大，幾個世紀以來一直是哈布斯堡帝國的一部分。與貝爾格萊德等姊妹城市不同，市中心結構緊湊，非常適合步行且上鏡，極簡的社會主義時代建築破壞了舊世界的氛圍。還有令人驚嘆的背景：向北行駛 30 分鐘，白雪皚皚的阿爾卑斯山雄偉地矗立在天際線之上。只要在盧布爾雅那待幾個小時，它的名字翻譯過來就是“心愛的”，也就不足為奇了。

body.en: In Ybor City, the past and present blend like the perfect café Cubano—rich, bold, and impossible to resist. Situated just northeast of downtown Tampa, Florida, the enclave was founded when Cuban cigar entrepreneur Vincente Martinez-Ybor opened a factory here in the 1880s. That one business move created a boom for cigars (at its height, Ybor City had more than 200 cigar factories), prompting an explosion of lodging, restaurants, shops and nightclubs. Today, it’s still a haven for vibrant cultural touchpoints that blend its Cuban roots with Floridian, Spanish, Italian and global influences from farther-flung locations. On its charming streets, guests will find Cuban eateries ranging from traditional to creative, and cigar shops (and even a working factory) that retains the spirit of its past. From picadillo to hand-rolled cigars, Ybor City has plenty of treasures to offer. A word to the wise: Come hungry for discovery.
body.zh: 在易博城，過去與現在的融合就像完美的古巴咖啡館一樣——豐富、大膽、令人無法抗拒。這片飛地位於佛羅裡達州坦帕市中心東北部，是古巴雪茄企業家 Vincente Martinez-Ybor 於 1880 年代在此開設工廠時建立的。這項商業舉措引發了雪茄的繁榮（在鼎盛時期，Ybor 市擁有 200 多家雪茄工廠），引發了住宿、餐廳、商店和夜總會的爆炸式增長。如今，它仍然是充滿活力的文化接觸點的天堂，將古巴根源與佛羅裡達、西班牙、義大利和來自更遠地區的全球影響融為一體。在其迷人的街道上，客人會發現從傳統到創意的古巴餐館，以及保留著過去精神的雪茄店（甚至還有仍在運營的工廠）。從皮卡迪羅雪茄到手捲雪茄，易博城擁有許多珍寶。對智者的一句話：渴望發現。

body.en: From legendary outlaw hideouts and prehistoric fossil beds, to a centuries-old Native American rock formation and a critical landmark along the Oregon Trail, Wyoming is packed with storied sites worth seeing. Here’s 10 fascinating stops to get you started.
body.zh: 從傳奇的亡命之徒藏身處和史前化石床，到數百年歷史的美洲原住民岩層和俄勒岡步道沿線的重要地標，懷俄明州充滿了值得一看的傳奇景點。這裡有 10 個令人著迷的網站可以幫助您入門。

body.en: With its endangered Florida scrub jays, athletic bobcats, fields of colorful wildflowers, and eerie mangrove tunnels, southwest Florida’s Sarasota County is far from one note. While it offers the requisite Sunshine State landscapes of pristine beaches and lapping waves, there’s so much more for nature lovers to see and experience. With 725 square miles—including 35 miles of beachfront overlooking the glittering Gulf of Mexico—Sarasota County has varied landscapes that support all manner of wildlife. Whether you’re looking for a low-key stroll beneath moss-draped trees, the rush of seeing hundreds of alligators converging in one place, or an exploratory horseback ride, this extraordinary area has you covered. Here, we’ve rounded up nine can’t-miss Sarasota stops, so get ready for the ultimate outdoor lovers’ excursion. Trust us: Sarasota County hits all of the high notes.
body.zh: 佛羅裡達州西南部的薩拉索塔縣擁有瀕臨滅絕的佛羅裡達灌木叢鴉、運動型山貓、色彩繽紛的野花田和怪異的紅樹林隧道，這些都不是值得注意的地方。雖然它提供了陽光之州必備的原始海灘和拍打的海浪景觀，但對於自然愛好者來說，還有更多值得觀賞和體驗的東西。薩拉索塔縣佔地 725 平方英里，其中包括 35 英里的海濱，俯瞰波光粼粼的墨西哥灣，擁有多樣的景觀，適合各種野生動物生存。無論您是想在長滿青苔的樹下低調漫步，還是想觀看數百隻鱷魚聚集在一個地方，或者進行一次探索性的騎馬，這個非凡的地區都能滿足您的需求。在這裡，我們收集了九個不容錯過的薩拉索塔站點，所以準備好迎接戶外愛好者的終極旅行。相信我們：薩拉索塔縣達到了所有高調。

body.en: California is a land of dramatic landscapes. It has mountains, volcanoes, sweeping deserts and seashore galore; its natural splendor even extends below the surface of the earth, to cavernous caves and man-made underground gardens. Many of its geological and biological wonders will make you feel like you’re on another planet, or like you’ve been transported to a storybook where trees speak, shrink, or live forever. Whether you’re eager to explore volcanic history, surround yourself with walls of glistening ferns, or summit mountains to see twisting trees and desert views, in California, the most unbelievable landscapes are just around the corner.
body.zh: 加州是一片風景優美的土地。這裡有山脈、火山、廣闊的沙漠和廣闊的海岸；它的自然光彩甚至延伸到地表以下，延伸到洞穴和人造地下花園。它的許多地質和生物奇觀會讓您感覺自己身處另一個星球，或者就像您被傳送到一本故事書中，那裡的樹木會說話、收縮或永遠活著。無論您是渴望探索火山歷史、置身於閃閃發光的蕨類植物牆中，還是登上山頂欣賞扭曲的樹木和沙漠景觀，在加利福尼亞州，最令人難以置信的景觀就在眼前。

body.en: California’s long coast is beloved by surfers, sure, but it’s also a hotbed for another sort of sunny activity: tide pool exploration. At low tide along California’s shoreline, pools of tiny living wonders appear – home to sea stars, urchins, spiny lobsters, slugs, shells and flowing bits of algae. We’ve rounded up some of the best tide pools in the state, to inspire the budding marine biologist in all of us. Know Before You Go Before you begin your tide pool adventure, there are a few things you should know. 1. First, check the tide schedule before you set off for the beach, as most of these tide pools are only visible at low tide. (Fall and Winter are usually the best seasons for this sort of exploration, as the tides are lower.) 2. In order to preserve the wild world of nature that exists inside each tide pool, you should never remove any animals from their habitats; some state parks even forbid touching the animals inside the tide pools, so follow the local rules at every stop along the way.
body.zh: 當然，加州漫長的海岸深受衝浪者的喜愛，但它也是另一種陽光活動的溫床：潮汐池探索。退潮時，沿著加州海岸線，會出現一池池微小的生物奇觀，這裡是海星、海膽、大龍蝦、蛞蝓、貝殼和流動藻類的家。我們收集了該州一些最好的潮汐池，以激勵我們所有人中嶄露頭角的海洋生物學家。出發前須知 在開始潮池探險之前，您應該了解一些事項。 1. 首先，在前往海灘之前檢查潮汐表，因為大多數潮汐池僅在退潮時可見。 （秋季和冬季通常是此類探索的最佳季節，因為潮汐較低。）2. 為了保護每個潮汐池內存在的野生自然世界，切勿將任何動物移出其棲息地；一些州立公園甚至禁止觸摸潮汐池內的動物，因此沿途每一站都要遵守當地的規定。

body.en: For those of us who live in colder climates, California can seem a legitimate dream: sunny beaches, temperate mountain vistas, and awe-inspiring desert landscape. In every season, the Golden State is rife with opportunities for strolling, hiking, and rambling through its diverse climates and thrilling geographies. You can walk breezy beaches and see a waterfall that crashes directly into the sea, climb the country’s highest sand dunes, explore a glistening green canyon, or even go subterranean. Whatever you choose, we’ve collected 10 great ways to see the state on foot.
body.zh: 對於我們這些生活在寒冷氣候的人來說，加州似乎是一個合理的夢想：陽光明媚的海灘、溫和的山景和令人驚嘆的沙漠景觀。每個季節，金州都充滿了漫步、遠足和漫步的機會，穿越其多樣的氣候和令人興奮的地理環境。您可以漫步在微風習習的海灘上，欣賞直接墜入大海的瀑布，攀登該國最高的沙丘，探索閃閃發光的綠色峽谷，甚至進入地下。無論您選擇哪種方式，我們都收集了 10 種徒步遊覽該州的絕佳方式。

body.en: There’s more to Mardi Gras than the raucous parade on Bourbon Street.
